halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.description: Halo: Reach: Thola isiginesha kanambambili efihliwe.
halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"I'm Sorry, Dave" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), udinga ukuthola iqanda lephasika elithile elihlonipha u-David Candland, umqondisi we-UI womdlalo. Nawu umhlahlandlela onemininingwane wokuthi ungayithola kanjani:

1. Qala noma yimuphi umsebenzi womkhankaso noma imephu yabadlali abaningi kokuthi Halo: Reach.
2. Thatha isikhali **esingenaso** isici sobubanzi bokusondeza. Izibonelo ezijwayelekile zihlanganisa i-Assault Rifle noma i-Plasma Pistol.
3. Cindezela inkinobho yokusondeza (ngokuvamile induku engakwesokudla kumakhonsoli noma ukhiye oqokiwe ku-PC) ukuze "zoom in" ngesikhali sakho esingasikiwe.
4. Bhekisisa*ekhoneni elingezansi kwesokunxele** lesikrini sakho. Uzoqaphela uchungechunge lwekhodi kanambambili luvela kafushane.
5. Le khodi kanambambili ihumusha egameni elithi "Dave" ekumeleleni kanambambili kwe-ASCII.

Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo futhi ubheke ikhodi kanambambili, uzovula impumelelo ye-"I'm Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-balaho-s-most-wanted-03c5a591ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Balaho's Most Wanted" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), uzodinga ukususa inani elihlanganisiwe lama-Grunts angu-100 kumodi ye-PVE, ehlanganisa umkhankaso, i-Firefight, kanye ne-Spartan Ops. Ngenhlanhla, le mpumelelo ingavulwa kalula ngokudlala ngokujwayelekile.

halomcc-just-a-taste-9a52606cd4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Just A Taste" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), uzodinga ukuqoqa imikhankaso engu-500 noma izindondo zohlu lwadlalwayo. Lezi zindondo zingatholwa ngenkathi udlala umkhankaso noma ubambe iqhaza ekwenzeni umentshisi. Ukuze wandise inqubekelaphambili yakho, gxila ekubulaleni izitha ngokushesha nangempumelelo, uhlose ukubulala okuningi nokubulala izindondo ze-spree. Ukudlala ngobunzima obulula emkhankasweni kuyanconywa, njengoba kukuvumela ukuthi uqongelele izindondo ngaphandle kwenselelo eyengeziwe yobunzima obuphezulu.

halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.description: Dlala umdlalo wabadlali abaningi noma wokubambisana okungenani izinyanga ezi-3 ngemuva kwegeyimu yakho yokuqala.
halomcc-stick-with-it-a-little-longer-17.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Stick With It...A Little Longer" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), udinga nje ukudlala umdlalo wabadlali abaningi noma wokuhlanganyela okungenani izinyanga ezingu-3 ngemva kokudlala igeyimu yakho yokuqala.

Ngokungafani nezinye izimpumelelo, lena ayikwazi ukuvulwa ngokukhohlisa idethi yesistimu yakho, njengoba iqinisekiswa iseva.

halomcc-pillar-of-autumn-ca48de1ce8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"Pillar of Autumn" ku-Halo: CE ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), udinga nje ukudlala umkhankaso we-"Pillar of Autumn" kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekupheleni kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.

halomcc-the-guardians-are-coming-f21d333.guideDescription:
Impumelelo ye-"The Guardians Are Coming" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) ingavulwa ngokuhlangabezana nesiphetho esingajwayelekile: ukubulawa ngendlela edida injini yegeyimu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, igeyimu ivamise ukubonisa umlayezo, "You were killed by The Guardians." Nansi indlela eqondile yokuzuza le mpumelelo:

1. Kumenyu enkulu yokuthi Halo MCC, khetha umkhankaso othi Halo 2.
2. Hamba kumishini khetha.
3. Setha ugebhezi lwe-scarab njengolusebenzayo.
4. Layisha i-mission yokuqala nanoma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi owuthandayo.
5. Dlala uze uthole isikhali.
6. Dubula phansi.
7. Impumelelo ivuliwe!

Uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo, uzoba ne-"The Guardians Are Coming" eqoqweni lakho.

halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.description: Halo CE: Yilwa eduze no-Chips Dubbo futhi ulalele amazwi akhe okuhlakanipha.
halomcc-my-buddy-chips-b7c213043b.guideDescription:
Ukuze uthole impumelelo ye-"My Buddy Chips" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection, udinga ukuhlangana nomlingisi u-Chips Dubbo phakathi nomkhankaso Halo: Combat Evolved. Angatholakala emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, kodwa abadlali abaningi baye baphumelela ku-mission "The Pillar of Autumn."

Gcina osolwandle bakho bephila, ikakhulukazi phakathi nesigaba lapho amabutho eSivumelwano egibela khona umkhumbi wakho, futhi ulalele inkhulumomphendvulwano ehlukile ye-Dubbo. Impumelelo kufanele ivuleke ngemva kwalokhu kuhlangana.

Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi ukubukeka kweChips Dubbo kungaba okungahleliwe ngandlela thile, futhi uma unenkinga yokumthola, zama ukudlala kabusha umkhankaso futhi uwuthathe kancane, uqinisekise ukuthi uhlala namasosha akho futhi ulalele yonke inkhulumomphendvulwano1 yabo.

halomcc-i-need-a-weapon-0305f283a3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"I Need A Weapon" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), udinga nje ukudlala umkhankaso we-"Nightfall" kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekupheleni kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.

Okuqondiwe kungaba unjiniyela noma yimuphi umdlali osevele enale mpumelelo, ngakho qhubeka udlala uze uthole ukubulala okufanelekile. Ividiyo ibonisa inguqulo yokuqala ye-Halo 4 yempumelelo, esebenzisa isiqalisi esifanayo sokufanisa.

halomcc-sacrifice-1348414136.guideDescription:
Njengoba uthuthukela kuleveli, uzofika endaweni lapho u-Cortana ephawula khona, "This cave is not a natural formation." Uzobe ushayela i-Warthog yakho ngenethiwekhi yamathaneli. Naka kakhulu njengoba uzulazula kule ndawo. Ufuna indlela encane eseceleni ephambuka emzileni omkhulu.

Le ndlela ifihlekile ngandlela thize, ngakho-ke kulula ukuyigeja uma ushesha. Yehlisa ijubane futhi uhlale ubheke imbobo encane ngakwesokudla somhume. Itholakala ngemuva kwesakhiwo esikhulu, esikhanyisiwe esigqama endaweni ezungezile. Uma usuyibonile i-alley, shayela kuyo bese wehla ku-Warthog yakho.

Itheminali ibekwe lapha, ilinde ukwenziwa isebenze. Sondela kuyo futhi uhlanganyele ukuze uvule impumelelo.

halomcc-no-picnic-a42a690adf.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule impumelelo ye-"No Picnic" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo:

1. Qala umsebenzi ka-Eksodusi.
2. Njengoba uqala umkhankaso, wehla ngokushesha ngerempu uqonde kunhloso yakho yokuqala.
3. Thola ubhaka webhere phansi phakathi kwezidumbu ezansi kwegquma eduze nomnyango wokuqala ohlangana nawo.
4. Chitha imizuzwana embalwa ubuka ibhere. Lena "grizzly scene" okudingeka uyiqaphele.
5. Ngemva kokuhlola i-teddy bear, impumelelo ye-"No Picnic" kufanele ivele!

Khumbula, ayikho ezingeni i-New Alexandria, ngaphandle kwencazelo edukisayo. Empeleni iku-Eksodusi. Ngakho-ke, hlala ubhekile lowo bhaka webhere le-teddy! 🐻

Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uhlonze ingqopha-mlando nendlela osondela ngayo. Uma kuyinto, sondela eduze ngokwanele ukuze uxhumane nayo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka endaweni.

halomcc-roses-vs-violets-b888123b73.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Roses vs Violets" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), layisha Isiqephu 1, Isahluko 5 se-Spartan Ops bese ubheka iqanda elifihliwe Elibomvu eliqhathaniswa ne-Blue Easter. Landela umzila kuvidiyo, yenza into ebonisiwe isebenze, futhi uhlale kungxoxo.

halomcc-top-gungoose-2bf771f5b3.description: Halo 2A MP: Thola ukubulala ngeGungoose ngenkathi usemoyeni.
halomcc-top-gungoose-2bf771f5b3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Top Gungoose" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola ukubulawa ngeGungoose ngenkathi uhamba emoyeni. Sebenzisa isikhali, imoto, noma indawo efanayo eboniswe kuvidiyo. Uma igoli lidinga ukushaywa kokugcina okuqondile, yeka ukwenza omunye umonakalo uma ithagethi isibuthakathaka.

halomcc-did-somebody-say-20baeed1ae.description: Halo CE: Shaya ngesikhathi kuwo wonke amazinga e-Halo: CE.
halomcc-did-somebody-say-20baeed1ae.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Did Somebody Say..." kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala futhi umkhankaso ngamunye odingekayo kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy bese uvule isibali sikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela ngokumelene nethagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Hamba phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola ngokushesha futhi ulwe kuphela lapho ukuhlangana noma umgomo uvimba ukuqhubeka. Hlola amarekhodi emishini ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izikhathi ezishodayo.

halomcc-the-goose-is-loose-23df65945e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Goose is Loose" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola ukubulala okungu-25 nge-Gungoose kubadlali abaningi. Vumela abambisene nabo basebenzise izimoto ezitholakalayo, futhi basebenzise izikhali nezindawo ukuze banqamule izindawo ezivelile ngaphandle kokugibela.

halomcc-10-minutes-too-early-8b5bb540de.description: Halo 2: Ku-Oracle, thola i-holo-drone ngaphambi kokuthi uMholi Wembuka ayenze isebenze.
halomcc-10-minutes-too-early-8b5bb540de.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "10 Minutes Too Early" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ku-The Oracle, thola iphrojektha yehologram ngaphambi kokuba uMholi Wembuka ayisebenzise. Hlola umzila oseceleni oboniswe kuvidiyo ngaphambi kokudlulela kumhlangano wokugcina.

halomcc-shoot-and-scoot-67c151c596.description: H3: ODST: Qedela i-NMPD HQ ngaphandle kokudubula i-Sniper Rifle ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-shoot-and-scoot-67c151c596.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Shoot and Scoot" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela i-NMPD HQ ngaphandle kokudubula i-Sniper Rifle kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Qala i-mission kusukela ekuqaleni, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ululame phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi ulandele umzila kuvidiyo. Zama futhi ukugijima uma wephula isimo senselele.

halomcc-power-play-9ea501eed5.description: Halo 2A MP: Ku-Warlord, thola amandla okufihla ama-5 asebenzayo kugeyimu eyodwa.
halomcc-power-play-9ea501eed5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Power Play" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ku-Warlord, thola i-Active Camouflage spawn bese uzicoshela yona. Buyela ngaso sonke isikhathi uma iphinda iveza kuze kube yilapho usuthathe amandla amahlanu kugeyimu efanayo.

halomcc-sample-plate-253120cbfb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sample Plate" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso zeqoqo bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. halomcc-left-behind-ce374239d4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Left Behind" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vumela ukushaya futhi ulayishe i-Lone Wolf. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ugcine izitha zingakuzungezile futhi ubulale ama-chain ukuthola amabhonasi wamaphuzu. Finyelela ku-30,000 ngaphambi kokuphela kwemishini.

halomcc-lore-master-f414ffc6cb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lore Master" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), yenza kusebenze Amatheminali omkhankaso kulo lonke iqoqo. Landela ngomkhondo izimpumelelo zeTheminali ngomdlalo futhi usebenzise imihlahlandlela ngayinye yemishini yanoma yikuphi okugejile. Shintshela ezibukweni ezibuye zaqiniswa ze-Halo: CE Terminals.

halomcc-aficiando-079c841600.description: Halo 3: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 3.
halomcc-aficiando-079c841600.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Aficiando" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo 3 bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. halomcc-pacifist-0dca677c00.description: Halo CE: Qedela Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule ngaphandle kokudubula, amabhomu, i-melee, ukufa noma ukuqala kabusha.
halomcc-pacifist-0dca677c00.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Pacifist" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala I-Cartographer Ethule ku-Easy futhi usebenzise i-Warthog ukuze ufinyelele esiteshini sezokuphepha kanye noMdwebi wamabalazwe. Gijimani izitha ezedlule futhi nifinyelele ekukhishweni ngaphandle kokudubula, ukujikijela amabhomu, usebenzisa i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.

halomcc-feet-first-a0627d5182.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops.
halomcc-feet-first-a0627d5182.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Feet First" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-like-a-broken-record-96d049ddc6.description: H3: ODST: Thola inkomba yomculo efihliwe.
halomcc-like-a-broken-record-96d049ddc6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Like a Broken Record" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola inkomba yomculo efihliwe. Landela ividiyo kusuka endaweni eseduze noma indawo yokuhlola. Linda endaweni isikhathi eside ngokwanele ukuze ithrekhi iqale.

halomcc-trophy-collector-c5e82d06f8.description: Halo 2: Thola futhi ufune zonke izingebhezi ku-Halo 2.
halomcc-trophy-collector-c5e82d06f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule impumelelo ethi "Trophy Collector" ku-Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela uhlu olukuvidiyo ukuze uqoqe ugebhezi ngalunye lomkhankaso. Vula i-Mission Select ukuze udlale kabusha amazinga onezinto ongakazitholi. Qala ngaphambi kwendawo ugebhezi olufihlwe kuyo, bese udlala ngezinga lobunzima elithi Legendary.

halomcc-grand-theft-halo-acf75eecbb.description: Halo 2A MP: Komdlalo owodwa, ntshontsha isamba sezimoto ezi-5 ezigcwele kwabamelene nawe.
halomcc-grand-theft-halo-acf75eecbb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Grand Theft Halo" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary phakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), emdlalweni owodwa Halo 2: Anniversary, sondela ezimotweni zesitha ezihlala abantu, sebenzisa umyalo wokugibela ukuze uhlale esihlalweni, futhi ushiye imoto ukusetha enye imoto. Phinda ukuthatha okuhlanu okuyimpumelelo.

halomcc-chol-von-s-not-gonna-like-this-4.guideDescription: Ukuvula "Chol Von's Not Gonna Like This" ku-Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa ama-Skirmishers angu-1000. Namathela ku-Halo: Reach kulesi sibalo. Dlala kabusha umkhankaso wangaphambi kwesikhathi Halo: Reach ngama-Skirmisher. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-monumental-thirst-bba3cbaeae.description: I-H2A: Kutholwe futhi kwacekelwa phansi i-BLAST soda can ku-Remnant.
halomcc-monumental-thirst-bba3cbaeae.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Monumental Thirst!" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), layisha iRemnant ku-Halo 2: Anniversary yabadlali abaningi. Landela ividiyo ukusuka endaweni yokuzalela kuya ekani elifihliwe le-BLAST, bese uyithwebula ize inqamuke.

halomcc-keep-your-foot-on-the-pedrogas-3.description: Halo: Reach: Qedela konke Halo: Reach ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-keep-your-foot-on-the-pedrogas-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Keep Your Foot on the Pedrogas" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-red-vs-blue-75b3a0e6ad.description: Halo 2A MP: Wina imidlalo engu-10 ku-Bloodline kubadlali abaningi.
halomcc-red-vs-blue-75b3a0e6ad.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Red vs. Blue" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala abadlali abaningi ku-Bloodline ku-Halo 2: Anniversary futhi uwine imidlalo engu-10 kuleyo mephu. Hlala ubheka imiphumela isikhathi ngasinye ukuze ukuwina kubalwe.

halomcc-planting-a-flag-c1e64a70e0.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo Eziqondile zemodi ye-CTF engu-250 kumageyimu enziwe umeshi.
halomcc-planting-a-flag-c1e64a70e0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Planting A Flag" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo eziqondile zemodi ye-CTF engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Ulayini Wokuthwebula Ifulegi nokusekela ukubanjwa kwefulegi, ukubuyiselwa, nokuthwebula. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-vandalized-8bfaec17ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vandalized" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ngesikhathi se-NMPD HQ, bheka i-graffiti efihliwe futhi ubhekane nayo eduze. Sebenzisa umzila kuvidiyo kunokushiya indawo usuka emgomweni oyinhloko.

halomcc-term-of-enlistment-1ccd9e3baa.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops ngobunzima obujwayelekile.
halomcc-term-of-enlistment-1ccd9e3baa.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Term of Enlistment" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Okujwayelekile. halomcc-life-story-3bd7404961.description: Gcwalisa uhlu lwadlalwayo lwe-Master Chief Saga.
halomcc-life-story-3bd7404961.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Life Story" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula imenyu yohlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso wegeyimu bese uqala i-Master Chief Saga. Qhubeka nomsebenzi usebenzisa ukulondoloza uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo, futhi uqedele umgomo walo wokugcina wokurekhoda uhlu lwadlalwayo ngokucacile.

halomcc-destination-vacation-4f15643689.description: Halo 2: Buka olunye lwezimpawu zesizini e-Zanzibar kubadlali abaningi bakudala.

halomcc-can-t-stop-here-this-is-brute-co.description: H3: ODST: Shaya ngesikhathi kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 3: ODST.
halomcc-can-t-stop-here-this-is-brute-co.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Can't Stop Here, This is Brute Country" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala kabusha umkhankaso ngamunye odingekayo kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy bese uvule isibali sikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela ngokumelene nethagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Hamba phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola ngokushesha futhi ulwe kuphela lapho ukuhlangana noma umgomo uvimba ukuqhubeka. Hlola amarekhodi emishini ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izikhathi ezishodayo.

halomcc-leave-it-where-it-lay-054f73d1ea.description: Halo CE: Qedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kubunzima benganekwane ngaphandle kokuthatha isikhali esisha.
halomcc-leave-it-where-it-lay-054f73d1ea.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Leave It Where It Lay" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala ama-Betrayals Okubili ku-Legendary futhi ugcine izikhali zakho zokuqala zawo wonke umsebenzi. Bagebhele izinhlamvu lapho ungakwazi khona, sebenzisa izimoto uma ziwusizo, futhi ugweme umyalo wokushintsha izikhali.

halomcc-tying-up-loose-ends-9a95e12ead.description: Halo CE: Bulala wonke ama-Elite asezingeni Okhiye kubunzima bobuqhawe noma benganekwane.
halomcc-tying-up-loose-ends-9a95e12ead.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tying Up Loose Ends" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), bulala wonke ama-Elite asezingeni elithi Keyes kubunzima Bomaqhawe noma Inganekwane. Sebenzisa isikhali, imoto, noma indawo efanayo eboniswe kuvidiyo. Uma igoli lidinga ukushaywa kokugcina okuqondile, yeka ukwenza omunye umonakalo uma ithagethi isibuthakathaka.

halomcc-excellent-taste-2c84d9a603.description: Halo CE: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ze-Halo: CE.
halomcc-excellent-taste-2c84d9a603.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Excellent Taste" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo CE bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-arcade-owner-c7cae0d138.description: Halo 2: Hlula amaphuzu alinganayo kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 2.
halomcc-arcade-owner-c7cae0d138.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Arcade Owner" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala kabusha ohambweni lomkhankaso oludingekayo kanye ngesikhathi Ukushaya kunikwe amandla futhi uhlose ukushaya ithagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Khetha ubunzima kanye nokushaya ama-Skulls ongakwazi ukuphatha, gcina ukubulala kanye nokulandelana kwezindondo, futhi uqedele kahle ukuze uvikele isiphindaphindi sakho sesikhathi.

halomcc-classic-0e64eaf3f4.description: H3: ODST: Qedela noma yiliphi izinga uwedwa ku-Legendary, ngaphandle kokudubula noma amabhomu.
halomcc-classic-0e64eaf3f4.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Classic" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qala i-Ulift Reserve uwedwa ku-Legendary.
2. Thatha umzila wemoto futhi usebenzise ukunyakaza ukuze uthole izitha ezedlule.
3. Ungalokothi uqhumise isibhamu noma ujikijele ibhomu ngaphambi kokufika endaweni yokugcina yemishini.

halomcc-starved-for-shields-6e0fbffdd6.description: Halo 2: Qedela ileveli nge-Streaking Skull kuphela esebenzayo kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-starved-for-shields-6e0fbffdd6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Starved For Shields" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula i-Streaking njengogebhezi lwakho kuphela bese uqala ileveli Halo 2 emfushane kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Hlela imihlangano ezungeze ukubulala okudingekayo ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu, sebenzisa ikhava phakathi kwezimpi, futhi uqedele lonke izinga.

halomcc-what-power-outage-15665534d2.description: Halo 4: Qedela i-Cauldron Base ye-Spartan Ops ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa i-generator ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-what-power-outage-15665534d2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "What Power Outage?" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela i-Cauldron Base ye-Spartan Ops ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ijeneretha ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane. Qala i-mission kusukela ekuqaleni, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ululame phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi ulandele umzila kuvidiyo. Zama futhi ukugijima uma wephula isimo senselele.

halomcc-throne-of-bones-cdb3f2b054.description: Thola futhi ufune zonke izingebhezi zomkhankaso ku-Halo:CE, Halo 2, kanye Halo 3.
halomcc-throne-of-bones-cdb3f2b054.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Throne of Bones" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qoqa yonke i-Skull yomkhankaso kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary, Halo 2: Anniversary, kanye nokuthi Halo 3. Hlola izimpumelelo ze-Skull zomkhankaso ngamunye futhi udlale kabusha ohambweni ngokuthatha okulahlekile.

halomcc-mortardom-2f3fdd6da4.description: Halo 4: Ku-Reclaimer, sebenzisa i-Wraith ukuze ubulale okungenani izitha ezine ze-Wraiths ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-mortardom-2f3fdd6da4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mortardom" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Reclaimer kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane bese uduna i-Wraith. Sebenzisa udaka lwayo ukuze ubhubhise ama-Wraiths amane ezitha. Bulisa kusukela ebangeni elide futhi uhambe ngemuva kwezwe ngemva kokudutshulwa ngakunye.

halomcc-bros-to-the-close-6c933f368d.description: Halo 4: I-Infinity ephelele ngaphandle kokufa okungavinjelwa kwasolwandle ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-bros-to-the-close-6c933f368d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bros to the Close" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Infinity kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane. Uma uhlangana namaMarines ungawavikela, ngena phakathi kwawo namaPrometheans. Beka kuqala Ababukeli nabanye abahlaseli abasabisa isikwati kuze kuphele inhloso yokugada.

halomcc-connoisseur-ac29fbde9f.description: Halo 2: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 2.
halomcc-connoisseur-ac29fbde9f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Connoisseur" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo 2 bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-easy-as-one-two-three-99f316a440.description: Halo 4: Betha isikhathi esilinganayo kuwo wonke amazinga Halo 4.
halomcc-easy-as-one-two-three-99f316a440.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Easy As One Two Three" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala futhi umkhankaso ngamunye odingekayo kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy bese uvule isibali sikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela ngokumelene nethagethi ekhonjiswe umgomo ngamunye. Hamba phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlola ngokushesha futhi ulwe kuphela lapho ukuhlangana noma umgomo uvimba ukuqhubeka. Hlola amarekhodi emishini ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izikhathi ezishodayo.

halomcc-devastating-79fd8dc925.description: Halo 3: Qedela konke Halo 3 ohambweni lomkhankaso wenganekwane ngaphansi kwamahora angu-3.
halomcc-devastating-79fd8dc925.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Devastating" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qedela ohambweni lomkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi ulethe isikhathi esirekhodiwe esihlanganisiwe sibe ngaphansi kwamahora amathathu. Dlala kusukela ekuqaleni kwe-mission ngayinye ngesikhathi esinikwe amandla, funda lapho ungeqa khona ukuhlangana, futhi udlale kabusha izigaba lapho ungonga khona isikhathi esiningi.

halomcc-elder-signs-0d5cac0902.description: Halo 3: Buka amasigil ahlukene angu-2 ku-Valhalla.
halomcc-elder-signs-0d5cac0902.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Elder Signs" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), buka amasiginali angu-2 ahlukene ku-Valhalla. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uhlonze ingqopha-mlando nendlela osondela ngayo. Uma kuyinto, sondela eduze ngokwanele ukuze uxhumane nayo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka endaweni.

halomcc-one-final-firefight-3f94462e52.description: Halo: Reach: Thola amaphuzu angu-150,000 ku-Lone Wolf.
halomcc-one-final-firefight-3f94462e52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "One Final Firefight" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Lone Wolf nge-Score enikwe amandla. Thola ikhava evikelekile, qoqa izikhali ezitheni eziwile, nezindondo zamaketanga esikhundleni sokujaha izitha endaweni evulekile. Hlala uphila kuze kube yilapho isikolo sakho sifinyelela ku-150,000.

halomcc-look-out-for-the-little-guys-63b.description: Halo CE: Qedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kubunzima benganekwane ngaphandle kokubulala ama-Grunts.
halomcc-look-out-for-the-little-guys-63b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Look Out for the Little Guys" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala ama-Betrayals Okubili kokuthi Inganekwane. Shiya ama-Grunts yedwa, sebenzisa izikhali ezinembile lapho izitha ziqoqwa, futhi ugweme ukulimala kwesplash kusuka kumabhomu noma umlilo wemoto. Qedela umkhankaso ngaphandle kokuthola ikhredithi ngokubulala kwe-Grunt.

halomcc-the-return-of-megg-1a371750ec.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"The Return of Megg" ku-Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kwe-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Cairo Station ku-Legendary bese ulandela umzila ofihliwe ngaphandle kokushaya into edingekayo yokuvula. Finyelela indawo kuvidiyo bese ulinda inkhulumomphendvulwano ekhethekile. Zama futhi endaweni yokuhlola yangaphambilini uma wenza umonakalo.

halomcc-shiny-0eb73b2d94.description: H3: ODST: Shayela i-Banshee ku-Kizingo Boulevard.
halomcc-shiny-0eb73b2d94.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Shiny..." kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-Kizingo Boulevard futhi uthathe umzila oboniswe kuvidiyo ukuze ufike ku-Banshee. Ngena esihlalweni somshayeli undize imoto ukuze uqalise impumelelo.

halomcc-wetwork-7f2ab9761b.description: Halo 2A MP: Ku-Shrine ku-CTF, yenza impophoma yesisekelo sesitha isebenze futhi, ngaphambi kokuthi ime, bamba ifulegi.
halomcc-wetwork-7f2ab9761b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wetwork" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), dlala i-CTF ku-Shrine futhi ufinyelele iswishi sempophoma yesisekelo sesitha. Yenze isebenze futhi ufike kufulegi labo ngaphambi kokuthi amanzi ame. Setha umzila wakho oya efulegini ngaphambi kokucindezela iswishi.

halomcc-icarus-014be3815c.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops ezimayelana nobunzima benganekwane.
halomcc-icarus-014be3815c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Icarus" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Inganekwane. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-catch-this-9bec9c9254.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo ezingama-500 zeGrenade Kill noma zePlasma Kill emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
halomcc-catch-this-9bec9c9254.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Catch This" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo ezingama-500 zeGrenade Kill noma zePlasma Kill emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Sebenzisa ama-Frag Grenade ukuze uqedele abaphikisi ababuthaka emakhoneni noma unamathisele isitha nge-Plasma Grenade. Ividiyo ikhombisa amabhomu abulalayo ongazijwayeza ukwenza umentshisi. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-no-easy-way-out-06bea3756d.description: Halo 4: Survive Spartan Miller (Ep.5 Ch.1) of Spartan Ops kokuthi Ubuqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-no-easy-way-out-06bea3756d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No Easy Way Out" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), khetha Isiqephu 5, Isahluko 1 (Spartan Miller) kokuthi Halo 4 Spartan Ops kokuthi Amaqhawe noma Inganekwane. Bamba amaphuzu okuzivikela futhi uqedele zonke izinjongo zesahluko.

halomcc-hazard-pay-221fb36ec0.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops zobunzima Bobuqhawe.
halomcc-hazard-pay-221fb36ec0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hazard Pay" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Iqhawe. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kweziyi-10. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-airborne-d25fa1e26b.description: Halo CE: Yethula i-Warthog okungenani imizuzwana emi-5 futhi uyenze isakaze isitha.
halomcc-airborne-d25fa1e26b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Airborne" kokuthi Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), setha ukwethulwa kwe-Warthog okuboniswa kuvidiyo futhi ugcine okuqondiwe endaweni yokufikela. Yethula i-Warthog kude ngokwanele ukuze uhlale emoyeni okungenani imizuzwana emihlanu, bese uhlala endaweni ehlosiwe ukuze uthole i-splatter.

halomcc-the-true-king-0d9ff94d2a.description: Zuza isamba sezindondo Eziqondile zemodi ye-KOTH engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
halomcc-the-true-king-0d9ff94d2a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The True King" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), thola izindondo eziqondile zemodi ye-KOTH engu-250 emidlalweni eyenziwe ngomentshisi. Faka umugqa we-King of the Hill futhi ulwele igquma elisebenzayo ukuze uzuze izindondo zalo ezihlosiwe. Qhubeka udlala ngemiphumela ukuze izindondo zibalwe.

halomcc-invaders-repelled-864c8db02b.description: Halo 2A MP: Enkosini Yentaba, bulala abaphikisi abangu-5 ngaphakathi kwegquma lakho elilawulwayo.
halomcc-invaders-repelled-864c8db02b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Invaders Repelled" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary King of the Hill, vumela iqembu lakho libambe igquma. Bulala izitha ezinhlanu ngenkathi zingaphakathi kwegquma olilawulayo. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphandle kwendlela yesitha ukuze ugcine ukubona indawo.

halomcc-annual-2fd4aca16c.description: Halo 3: Qedela i-Halo ku-4-player Legendary co-op, ne-Iron Skull, nawo wonke umuntu ku-Ghosts.
halomcc-annual-2fd4aca16c.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Annual" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Layisha i-Halo ku-Halo 3 ngabadlali abane be-co-op, i-Legendary ne-Iron inikwe amandla.
2. Ekubalekeni, thatha izipoki ezine futhi wonke umuntu ahlale kweyakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
3. Gcina iqembu lindawonye ukuze kungabikho muntu osalayo lapho egxuma.

halomcc-no-one-left-behind-309471e8e5.description: Halo 4: Londoloza okungenani i-Marine eyodwa ku-Hacksaw (Ep.2 Ch.3) ye-Spartan Ops kokuthi Ubuqhawe noma Inganekwane.
halomcc-no-one-left-behind-309471e8e5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No One Left Behind" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Hacksaw (Isiqephu 2, Isahluko 3) se-Halo 4 Spartan Ops ku-Heroic noma Inganekwane. Sula izitha ezizungeze i-Marines ngokushesha nje lapho ufika kuzo futhi uhlale useduze kuze kube yilapho okungenani oyedwa esinda ekuvikelweni.

halomcc-why-do-this-to-yourself-8f09d234.description: Halo: Reach: Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso we-Halo: Reach LASO.
halomcc-why-do-this-to-yourself-8f09d234.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Why Do This To Yourself?" kokuthi Halo: Reach ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso bese uqala uhlu lwadlalwayo olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lwe-LASO. Sebenzisa ama-Skulls ayo abelwe futhi uqedele ohambweni olulondolozwe uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo. Yilwa nekhava, sebenzisa i-melee ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu lapho i-Black Eye idinga khona, futhi ufinyelele ekupheleni komsebenzi wokugcina.

halomcc-smooth-operator-6241dc65c7.description: Halo 4: Qedela zonke izahluko Spartan Ops uwedwa kubunzima beLegendary.
halomcc-smooth-operator-6241dc65c7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Smooth Operator" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula okuthi Spartan Ops kokuthi Halo 4 bese usethe kokuthi Inganekwane. Qedela zonke izahluko ezinhlanu zesiqephu ngasinye kwezingu-10 ngaphandle kokujoyina omunye umdlali. Sebenzisa imenyu yesiqephu ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izahluko ezishoda ngokusobala.

halomcc-knightbane-2ce22a2464.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Knightbane" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa ama-Knights angu-1000. Dlala kabusha umgomo we-Halo 4 ngama-Prometheans noma ukhethe isahluko esithi Spartan Ops esiwafakayo. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-mind-the-gap-5a7512e684.description: Halo 3: Izimoto ezi-4, igebe eli-1 ku-Legendary kusetshenziswa i-Cowbell, i-Catch, i-Dunderstorm, i-Mythic, ne-Tough Luck.
halomcc-mind-the-gap-5a7512e684.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mind the Gap" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), layisha umgwaqo i-Tsavo Highway ku-Legendary nge-Cowbell, Catch, Thunderstorm, Mythic, ne-Tough Luck enikwe amandla. Qoqa izimoto ezine, uziyise esikhaleni, bese ulandela ukulandelana kwevidiyo ukuze uwele ngayinye. Gcina imoto ngayinye iqinile kuze kube yilapho igxuma.

halomcc-devotee-350c16c3c0.description: Halo 4: Gcwalisa izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu Halo 4.
halomcc-devotee-350c16c3c0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Devotee" kokuthi Halo 4 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso ze-Halo 4 bese ukhetha izinhla zokudlalayo ezintathu ezihlukene. Qedela yonke inhloso ohlwini lwadlalwayo ngalunye olukhethiwe ngaphandle kokushintshela kokuthi Ukukhetha Kwemishini. Izinhla zokudlalayo ezinetimu emfushane ziyindawo enhle yokuqala.

halomcc-safety-not-guaranteed-a5f5f800d4.description: H3: ODST: Gcwalisa uhlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso we-Halo 3: ODST LASO.
halomcc-safety-not-guaranteed-a5f5f800d4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Safety Not Guaranteed" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso bese uqala uhlu lwadlalwayo olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lwe-LASO. Sebenzisa ama-Skulls ayo abelwe futhi uqedele ohambweni olulondolozwe uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo. Yilwa nekhava, sebenzisa i-melee ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu lapho i-Black Eye idinga khona, futhi ufinyelele ekupheleni komsebenzi wokugcina.

halomcc-deja-vu-f401441a60.description: H3: ODST: Qedela umgwaqo omkhulu wasogwini ku-Legendary co-op yabadlali abangu-4, nge-Iron, futhi akukho 'Hog noma Scorpion.
halomcc-deja-vu-f401441a60.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Déjà Vu" kokuthi Halo 3: ODST ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), qala i-Coastal Highway ngokuhlanganyela kwabadlali abane ku-Legendary nge-Iron enikwe amandla. Sebenzisa ama-Mongoose nezikhali ezivela kunqolobane eseceleni ukuze uthole ukuphelezelwa komgwaqo omkhulu, futhi uqedele ngaphandle komuntu osebenzisa i-Warthog noma i-Scorpion.

halomcc-a-preference-for-pain-5d677bf840.description: Halo 3: Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso we-Halo 3 LASO.
halomcc-a-preference-for-pain-5d677bf840.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A Preference for Pain" kokuthi Halo 3 ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula Izinhla zokudlalayo Zomkhankaso bese uqala uhlu lwadlalwayo olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lwe-LASO. Sebenzisa ama-Skulls ayo abelwe futhi uqedele ohambweni olulondolozwe uhlu lwadlalwayo olufanayo. Yilwa nekhava, sebenzisa i-melee ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu lapho i-Black Eye idinga khona, futhi ufinyelele ekupheleni komsebenzi wokugcina.

halomcc-remove-the-bishops-from-the-boar.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Remove the Bishops From the Board" ku-Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), susa izibukeli eziyi-1000. Dlala kabusha umgomo we-Halo 4 ngama-Prometheans noma ukhethe isahluko esithi Spartan Ops esiwafakayo. Qhubeka ususa izitha ezifanelekile njengoba usebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo.

halomcc-roadkill-rampage-4bac3c2ffe.description: Halo 2A MP: Ekwenziweni komdlalo wokugubha iminyaka yonke, zuza isamba sezindondo eziyi-100 ze-Splatter.
halomcc-roadkill-rampage-4bac3c2ffe.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Roadkill Rampage" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ulayini Halo 2: Anniversary wokufanisa kumamephu anezimoto. Shayela phakathi kwezimbangi ukuze uthole izindondo ze-Splatter, sebenzisa i-boost yemoto lapho itholakala khona, futhi uqhubeke udlala uze uthole eziyi-100 zalezo zindondo.

halomcc-rock-and-coil-hit-back-d69ffbff3.description: Halo 2A MP: Ekwenziweni komdlalo wokugubha iminyaka yonke, zuza isamba sezindondo eziyi-100 ze-Environmentalist.
halomcc-rock-and-coil-hit-back-d69ffbff3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rock and Coil Hit Back" kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary ngaphakathi kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kokuthi Halo 2: Anniversary nokwenza umentshisi, sebenzisa izingozi zemephu ukuze uthole ukubulala. Beka iqhwa ku-Lockdown noma uqalise enye ingozi yokusebenzisana lapho ophikisana naye esendleleni yakhe. Bheka i-Environmentalist bese uphinda ukuthola izindondo eziyi-100.

halomcc-laso-master-f199f94aef.description: Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo oluqondene nomdlalo ngamunye we-LASO kuwo wonke umdlalo we-Halo.
halomcc-laso-master-f199f94aef.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "LASO Master" kokuthi Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), vula imenyu yohlu lwadlalwayo lomkhankaso ngamunye womdlalo ngamunye bese ukhetha uhlu lwawo olusemthethweni lwe-LASO. Qedela uhlu lwadlalwayo ngalunye kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni, uhlole okurekhodiwe okucacile ngaphambi kokushintshela emdlalweni olandelayo.

halo5-your-team-is-your-weapon-df4bf54c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Your Team is Your Weapon" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Osiris, khomba esitheni noma iphuzu eliphansi futhi usebenzise okokufaka komyalo we-fireteam okuboniswa kusakhiwo sakho sokulawula. Bheka ozakwenu ukuthi avume noma enze ngokuvumelana ne-oda.

halo5-your-style-1cb83e0602.description: Shintsha igiya lakho le-Spartan ku-Spartan Hub.
halo5-your-style-1cb83e0602.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Your Style" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula i-Spartan Hub bese uya ezinkethweni zokwenza ngokwezifiso zezikhali. Hlomisa isigqoko sokuzivikela esihlukile noma izivikelo zomzimba, bese uphuma noshintsho olusetshenzisiwe.

halo5-raise-your-banner-4fbc934e62.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Raise Your Banner" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula isihleli sezimpawu ku-Spartan Hub, khetha uphawu oluhlukile noma ushintshe ukwakheka kwalo, bese usebenzisa uphawu olusha.

halo5-make-your-mark-6bfdee7ee0.description: xhoma i-Service Tag yakho ku-Spartan Hub.
halo5-make-your-mark-6bfdee7ee0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Make Your Mark" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, hamba kuzinketho ze-Spartan ID ku-Spartan Hub. Hlela Ithegi Yesevisi, faka ithegi ehlukile evumelekile, bese uyiqinisekisa.

halo5-gamemaster-cbcad7ee4e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gamemaster" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Imidlalo Yangokwezifiso, vula izinketho zemodi yegeyimu, wenze ushintsho, futhi ulondoloze izilungiselelo zakho njengokuhlukile okusha. Qinisekisa ukulondoloza ngaphambi kokushiya indawo yokwamukela izivakashi.

halo5-benchwarmer-664674330b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Benchwarmer" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, vula uhlelo lomdlali kugeyimu ongayibona futhi ukhethe inketho yokubuka lapho itholakala. Linda ukuthi umdlalo ulayishwe bese ufaka ukubuka kwesibukeli.

halo5-cry-havoc-7d22e7cf90.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Cry Havoc" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka ulayini we-Warzone evamile ngokwenza okufanayo futhi uhlale kuze kube isikrini somphumela. Qedela ukufana okuthathu ngohlu lwadlalwayo.

halo5-bringing-in-the-big-guns-b34c4f315.description: Shayela i-REQ ebiza 5 Amandla noma ngaphezulu.
halo5-bringing-in-the-big-guns-b34c4f315.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bringing in the Big Guns" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Warzone, dlala izinjongo futhi wakhe ileveli yakho ye-REQ namandla. Ngemva kokufinyelela ileveli 5 noma ngaphezulu, vula isiteshi se-REQ noma sebenzisa imenyu yokuzala ukuze ushayele ikhadi elibiza okungenani amandla angu-5.

halo5-go-for-the-gold-8dc4251fd0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Go for the Gold" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kumenyu ye-REQ, vula i-Gold REQ Pack. Uma ungenayo, hlola amaphekhi atholakalayo futhi usebenzise amaphuzu e-REQ azuziwe lapho iphekhi linikezwa khona.

halo5-warlord-a212cef84d.description: Wina umdlalo kuwo womathathu amamephu wangempela we-Warzone.
halo5-warlord-a212cef84d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Warlord" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Warzone eyenziwe ngomdlalo futhi uwine ku-Escape from A.R.C., Raid on Apex 7, kanye no-March on Stormbreak. Landela ngomkhondo lawa mamephu amathathu ngokuhlukene futhi uhlale emiphumeleni ngemva kokuwina ngakunye.

halo5-castle-crasher-3a990a9032.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Castle Crasher" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa i-Strongholds futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Zungezisa phakathi kwezinqaba ezinobungane futhi usize ukuvikela izindawo zakho ezimbili ezibanjiwe. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-off-to-the-races-a244186313.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Off to the Races" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa iBreakout futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Hlala nethimba lakho ukuze nikwazi ukukhava omunye nomunye uma umzuliswano uqala. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-flag-monger-aa8dbd40ce.description: Qedela imidlalo emi-5 eyenziwe ngokufanisa ye-Capture the Flag.
halo5-flag-monger-aa8dbd40ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Flag Monger" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lwadlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa ukuthwebula ifulegi futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Vikela inkampani yenethiwekhi futhi usize ukubuyisela ifulegi lakho uma lithathwa. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-spartan-decimation-29dfec8727.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Spartan Decimation" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha uhlu lokudlalwayo lokufanisa oluhlanganisa i-Slayer futhi uqedele okufanayo okuhlanu kwaleyo modi. Yilwa eduze nozakwenu ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa umonakalo kanye nokuqedwa kohwebo. Hlala esikrinini semiphumela ukuze umdlalo ngamunye ubale.

halo5-into-the-fire-98f6f9e8b8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Into the Fire" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 1, "Osiris", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela i-Fireteam Osiris eqhweni nasezicishamlilo ukuze ufinyelele kuDkt. Halsey.

halo5-argent-moon-b807ecc1be.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Argent Moon" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 2, "Blue Team", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. I-Board Argent Moon njengeThimba Eliluhlaza. Sebenza esiteshini futhi ufinyelele ku-hangar ukuze ubaleke.

halo5-gravedigger-40680da6db.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gravedigger" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, cosha noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe phakathi nomsebenzi womkhankaso. Qala nge-Skull ku-Osiris futhi usebenzise ividiyo ukuze uthole i-ledge nendlela.

halo5-escape-4a597d2877.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Escape" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 6, "Evacuation", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Finyelela ilifti ye-orbital, bese usula izitha ku-elevator futhi uqhubeke uhamba ngokulandelana kokuphunyuka.

halo5-together-again-d9493fe6f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Together Again" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 7, "Reunion", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela umkhondo ngokusebenzisa umhosha. Sebenzisa i-Phaeton lapho itholakala khona futhi ubheke iphoyinti lendlela elilandelayo ngemva kwempi ngayinye.

halo5-reclamation-60ecda549a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Reclamation" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 13, "Genesis", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sebenzisa i-Scorpion ukusula umzila kuGenesise. Susa izinsongo ezinzima ukusuka kude ngaphambi kokuqhubekela phambili.

halo5-a-new-dawn-8878e6cc16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A New Dawn" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 14, "The Breaking", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula ukuhlangana kwe-Promethean ne-Blue Team futhi usebenzise ikhava ukuze uhlukanise ukunaka kwa-Wardens phakathi nempi yokugcina.

halo5-legacy-082348262b.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima obujwayelekile.
halo5-legacy-082348262b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Legacy" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ube Okuvamile futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-heroes-rise-3a4aeb757f.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima beHeroic.
halo5-heroes-rise-3a4aeb757f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Heroes Rise" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ube Obuqhawe futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-forging-a-legend-73e9979b0b.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo ngobunzima beLegendary.
halo5-forging-a-legend-73e9979b0b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Forging a Legend" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso kokuthi Inganekwane futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-conspiracy-theory-e31504ddf4.description: Thola futhi ufune ucezu olulodwa lwe-Intel.
halo5-conspiracy-theory-e31504ddf4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Conspiracy Theory" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Osiris, hlola izindawo zokuqala ze-Intel ekuhambeni okuxhunyiwe futhi usebenzise ukwaziswa kokuhlanganyela kokukodwa. Noma yimuphi umkhankaso oqoqekayo ubala i-Intel.

halo5-top-of-the-food-chain-1b09345cab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Top of the Food Chain" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Warzone, linda isimemezelo somphathi Wenganekwane. Iya kubasi omakiwe ngesikhali samandla noma imoto, yihlasele eduze kweqembu lakho, bese uzama ukushaya into eqeda lokho.

halo5-hunt-the-truth-693384dcee.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hunt the Truth" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa umkhankaso we-Intel kuzo zonke izimishini eziyi-15. Hlola ikhawunta ye-Intel ku-Mission Select, phinda udlale ohambweni ngokuthatha izithombe ezingekho, futhi usebenzise amavidiyo ahambayo ukuze uthole into ngayinye.

halo5-fire-drill-58cb781626.description: Qedela Ukuphunyuka phakathi kuka-18:00 ngaphandle kokushona ngobunzima Bobuqhawe.
halo5-fire-drill-58cb781626.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Fire Drill" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha u-Evacuation kokuthi Heroic futhi uqede emizuzwini engu-18 ngaphandle kokufa. Sebenzisa imoto ukuze uwele indawo evulekile kusenesikhathi, uye ngqo ekheshini, futhi ucashe phakathi nokuzivikela kwayo kokugcina.

halo5-gravelord-04e733d624.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gravelord" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa lonke ugebhezi lwekhanda olufihliwe phakathi nomkhankaso. Thatha ngayinye nge-Interact futhi uhlole ukuqhubeka kwe-Skull ku-Mission Select ngaphambi kokudlala kabusha ohambweni ngama-pickup angekho.

halo5-enemy-of-my-enemy-6d9377ce9b.description: Siza i-Elite General ikhokhise igquma e-Osiris ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-enemy-of-my-enemy-6d9377ce9b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Enemy of my Enemy" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Osiris ethi Heroic. Uma ufika eqenjini leSivumelwano eduze kwegquma, vumela i-Elite General iphile futhi ikhiphe ama-Prometheans avimbe umzila wakhe. Phusha naye esikhundleni sokusula iqembu lama-Elite.

halo5-i-thought-i-d-lost-you-b6d4b09d3e.description: Escape the Hunters elebhu futhi ulwe nabo ku-hangar ku-Blue Team.
halo5-i-thought-i-d-lost-you-b6d4b09d3e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I Thought I'd Lost You" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Blue Team, gijima udlule i-Hunters elebhu esikhundleni sokubabulala lapho. Qhubekela ku-hangar, bese usebenzisa ikhava ukuze uthole ngemuva kwalaba ababili futhi ulwe nabo lapho.

halo5-on-my-mark-62fbdf28ae.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bulala ama-Elite amabili ku-Blue Team co-op.
halo5-on-my-mark-62fbdf28ae.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "On My Mark" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Blue Team ngokubambisana. Umdlali ngamunye kufanele akhethe eyodwa yama-Elite amabili futhi ahambe ngemuva kwayo engabonwa. Bala phansi phezu kwengxoxo yezwi futhi ubambe i-melee ukuze uqale kokubili ukubulala ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-going-the-distance-88f98f8719.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Going the Distance" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala okuthi Glassed kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela umzila ngezinyawo futhi uwele izingxenye zemoto ngezinyawo futhi. Hlala kude nokwaziswa kwemoto yokungena kuze kuphele ukuthunyelwa.

halo5-shoot-from-the-hip-93e0a2cee9.description: Gcwalisa Ngengilazi ngaphandle kwabadlali abasebenzisa i-Smart-Link.
halo5-shoot-from-the-hip-93e0a2cee9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Shoot from the Hip" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala ethi Glassed and fire from the hip lonke. Gcina okokufaka kwe- aim-down-sights kungathintwa. Ngokusebenzisana, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umdlali uyazi ukugwema i-Smart-Link ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umkhankaso.

halo5-waiting-on-you-f1a60e2c48.description: Bulala isitha esilungiswe izikhali zaso kokuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe.
halo5-waiting-on-you-f1a60e2c48.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Waiting on You" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe, vumela Umbukeli alungise isitha esilimele se-Promethean. Uma usubona izikhali ezilungisiwe, gxilisa umlilo wakho kuleso sitha size sife.

halo5-maverick-231ad0ba79.description: Hlanganani emotweni ukuze nibulale izitha ezingu-30 ku-Co-op Engaqinisekisiwe.
halo5-maverick-231ad0ba79.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Maverick" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala okuthi Okungaqinisekisiwe ku-co-op bese ufaka abadlali ababili emotweni efanayo. Yenza oyedwa ashayele umzila wokudubula kuyilapho omunye esusa izitha. Hlalani ndawonye emotweni uze ubulale izitha ezingu-30.

halo5-savior-1ea30b51d7.description: Gcina abavukuzi abangu-6 bephila kukheshi ekuPhumeni ebunzimeni beHeroic.
halo5-savior-1ea30b51d7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Savior" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha u-Evacuation kokuthi Heroic. Ku-lifti, qhubekela phambili ngokushesha futhi ugxile ezitheni ezidubula abavukuzi. Bamba isikhundla ngokubuka kweqembu kuze kuphele ukulwa okungenani kubavukuzi abayisithupha besaphila.

halo5-take-a-hike-055accd709.description: Dabula umhosha ngaphandle kwe-Phaeton e-Reunion ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-take-a-hike-055accd709.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Take a Hike" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Reunion on Heroic, landela umhosha ngezinyawo kunokugibela i-Phaeton. Sula izinsongo zebanga elide kusukela embozweni futhi usebenzise amakhono akho okunyakaza ukweqa izikhala kumzila wokuhamba.

halo5-no-witnesses-13d17bfa3d.description: Bhubhisa i-Phantom ekamu leSivumelwano e-Reunion ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-no-witnesses-13d17bfa3d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No Witnesses" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Reunion on Heroic, finyelela ekamu Lesivumelwano uphethe isikhali esinzima esilungile. Qala ukudubula i-Phantom ngokushesha nje lapho une-engeli ehlanzekile bese ulehlisa ngaphambi kokuthi isuke.

halo5-no-knock-raid-483f37ce3a.description: Bhubhisa izindonga noma izitezi eziyi-10 ku-Swords of Sanghelios.
halo5-no-knock-raid-483f37ce3a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No Knock Raid" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Swords of Sanghelios, bheka izindonga eziqhekekile kanye naphansi ongaziphula nge-Spartan Charge noma i-Ground Pound. Bhubhisa izingcezu ezihlukene eziyi-10 njengoba udlula kumishini.

halo5-preying-mantis-79c750ada1.description: Qedela Izinkemba ze-Sanghelios zisebenzisana nazo zombili izithwalambiza ngobunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-preying-mantis-79c750ada1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Preying Mantis" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha izinkemba ze-Sanghelios ku-Heroic nozakwethu wokubambisana. Thatha isithwalambiza esisodwa ngamunye. Yilwani nisuka ebangeni nishintshane ngokudweba umlilo ukuze izithwalambiza zisinde kuze kube sekupheleni.

halo5-kraken-lackin-b4502f2080.description: Gcwalisa Imigqa Yezitha ngaphandle kokucekela phansi i-Kraken turret.
halo5-kraken-lackin-b4502f2080.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Kraken Lackin'" ku-Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Enemy Lines, ndiza uye e-Kraken futhi uhlale kuyo ngaphandle kokudubula ama-turrets ayo. Sula izisebenzi ngezinyawo, ucekele phansi umongo, futhi ushiye umkhumbi ngenkathi yonke i-turret isaphelele.

halo5-emergency-boarding-procedures-3e2f.description: Balekela i-Kraken elahlekile ngokugxumela ku-Phaeton eshayelwa i-Spartan.
halo5-emergency-boarding-procedures-3e2f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Emergency Boarding Procedures" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ngokubambisana ku-Enemy Lines, yiba nomshayeli wendiza oyedwa oyi-Phaeton futhi omunye acekele phansi i-Kraken core. Hambisa i-Phaeton eduze kwendawo yokugxuma yomdlali obalekile ukuze bagxume besuka eKraken bese begibela.

halo5-death-from-above-79ec279408.description: Bulala i-Grunt bese uphihliza i-grate nge-Ground Pound e-Battle of Sunaion.
halo5-death-from-above-79ec279408.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Death from Above" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, ku-Battle of Sunaion, thola i-Grunt emi phezu noma eduze kwe-grate ephukayo. Gxuma usuka phezulu futhi uqondise i-Ground Pound eshajiwe ukuze iphule i-grate futhi ibulale i-Grunt ngendlela efanayo.

halo5-worms-don-t-surf-9b98b41651.description: Khipha abazingeli ababili olwandle ngesikhathi seMpi yeSunaion.
halo5-worms-don-t-surf-9b98b41651.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Worms Don't Surf" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, e-Battle of Sunaion, yenga uMzingeli ngamunye emaphethelweni angaphandle abheke ulwandle. Sondela ukusuka ohlangothini lwezwe futhi usebenzise i-Spartan Charge noma i-knockback eboniswe kuvidiyo ukuze uphushe bobabili aba-Hunters.

halo5-tank-still-beats-everything-3bdef2.description: Qedela umsebenzi we-13 ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa i-Scorpion ebunzimeni be-Legendary.
halo5-tank-still-beats-everything-3bdef2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tank Still Beats Everything" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala uGenesise ku-Legendary futhi ugcine i-Scorpion iphila kuze kuphele umkhankaso. Khetsa izikhali ezisindayo kububanzi bamathangi futhi ubuyele ngemuva kwendawo lapho izitha zivala.

halo5-rolling-thunder-f02f07a818.description: Sebenzisa izimoto ezine ezahlukene ngesikhathi esisodwa ku-Mission 13 kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-rolling-thunder-f02f07a818.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rolling Thunder" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha iGenesis ku-Heroic nozakwethu abenele ukushayela izimoto ezine. Funa izinhlobo zezimoto ezine ezihlukene phakathi nomsebenzi futhi wenze bonke abadlali abane bashayele ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-harbinger-5bc36aeb44.description: Qedela i-The Breaking on Legendary difficulty ngaphandle kokuthi i-fireteam yonke ife.
halo5-harbinger-5bc36aeb44.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Harbinger" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala i-The Breaking on Legendary. Sebenzisa ikhava futhi uhlukanise ama-engeli akho okudubula ukuze ukuhlasela okukodwa kungakwazi ukwehlisa iqembu. Vuselela ama-Spartans awehlisiwe ngokushesha nje lapho kuphephile futhi uqedele umkhankaso ngaphandle kokusula okugcwele kwe-fireteam.

halo5-prison-break-f7063f1355.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bulala onogada ababili kubunzima be-Breaking on Heroic.
halo5-prison-break-f7063f1355.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Prison Break" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi The Breaking on Heroic, limaza Onogada ababili baze bacishe bahlulwe. Qondisa amagalelo okugcina nozakwenu noma uwashaye ndawonye ngomonakalo we-splash ukuze bobabili bafe ngesikhathi esisodwa.

halo5-icy-cool-e181026e33.description: Sebenzisa i-Ground Pound kumongo wamandla wangaphandle kokuthi Abaqaphi Kubunzima Bobuqhawe.
halo5-icy-cool-e181026e33.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Icy Cool" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, dlala i-Guardians on Heroic futhi ukhwele ngaphezu kweyodwa yama-core cores aveziwe. Gxumela kuyo, shaja i-Ground Pound emoyeni, bese uhlasela umgogodla.

halo5-double-stuff-27d0c0ec03.description: Ngesikhathi esifanayo bhubhisa ama-cores angu-2 ku-Guardians on Heroic difficulty.
halo5-double-stuff-27d0c0ec03.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Double Stuff" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Guardians on Heroic, yenza buthaka amakhora amabili angaphandle ngaphandle kokuwacekela phansi. Ngokuhlanganyela, nikeza umdlali ngamunye ingqikithi bese nibala phansi ukuze nithole amashothi okugcina ndawonye.

halo5-lone-wolf-5d71c25973.description: Qedela yonke iMishini yomdlalo uwedwa ngobunzima beLegendary.
halo5-lone-wolf-5d71c25973.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lone Wolf" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, setha umkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-15 ngaphandle kokujoyina omunye umdlali. Hlola ubunzima oburekhodiwe bomkhankaso ngamunye ku-Mission Select, futhi uthathe izimpi kusukela ekhava ukuze ithimba lomlilo likwazi ukuvuselela ama-Spartans awile.

halo5-one-for-all-6f2b07344d.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Co-op Mission kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-one-for-all-6f2b07344d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "One for All" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, mema omunye umdlali emkhankasweni futhi uqale inhloso ethi Heroic. Hlala ku-fireteam efanayo ngokusebenzisa indawo yokuhlola yokugcina nemiphumela. I-Osiris iyisinqumo esihle sokuqala.

halo5-all-for-one-a2633afb52.description: Qedela yonke i-Co-op Mission kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-all-for-one-a2633afb52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "All for One" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qedela wonke amamishini angu-15 nozakwethu wokubambisana ku-Heroic. Hlola i-Mission Select ukuze uthole irekhodi lobunzima be-co-op futhi udlale kabusha noma iyiphi i-mission ngaphandle kwe-Heroic co-op ecacile.

halo5-civil-war-dc3d88b430.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Civil War" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 12, "Battle of Sunaion", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Dlulela ngaphesheya kweSunaion ngamabutho e-Arbiter. Buka izikhala ezindleleni zokuhamba futhi usule izitha endaweni ekhavayo ngaphambi kokuphushela ezinkundleni eziveziwe.

halo5-my-rules-4110cad7e5.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Mission nge-3+ Skulls esebenzayo kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halo5-my-rules-4110cad7e5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "My Rules" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qoqa okungenani ama-Skulls amathathu, bese ukhetha injongo emfushane owazi kahle. Isethe ku-Heroic, nika amandla ama-Skulls amathathu noma ngaphezulu kuzinketho zemishini, futhi uqedele ngawo asebenzayo.

halo5-valor-recognized-b8faabe538.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Valor Recognized" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka umugqa ohlwini lokudlalayo olusezingeni elilodwa futhi uqedele ukufana kokubekwa. Qedela isethi egcwele kulolo hlu lwadlalwayo kuze kube yilapho igeyimu ikunikeza Isilinganiselwa Sekhono Esiqhudelanayo.

halo5-glasslands-32b615bb58.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Glasslands" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 3, "Glassed", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela umzila oya e-Meridian futhi uvikele ithimba lakho njengoba usula ukuhlangana kwe-Promethean. Sebenzisa imoto lapho inhloso ikunikeza khona ukuze udlule ezindaweni ezivulekile.

halo5-roots-of-the-earth-3672c85d5b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Roots of the Earth" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 4, "Meridian Station", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela imiyalo yokusebenzisana e-Meridian Station futhi ukhulume nabalingiswa abamakiwe ukuze uqhubekisele phambili indaba.

halo5-stolen-gauntlet-b41a706287.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Stolen Gauntlet" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 5, "Unconfirmed", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Phusha endaweni yezimayini futhi uhlale eduze nekhava ngaphambi kwe-Warden Eternal fight. Zungezisa ukuhlasela kwakhe ukuze uthole isibhamu emhlane wakhe.

halo5-swords-756823ffa2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Swords" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 8, "Swords of Sanghelios", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Phusha ezindaweni zeSivumelwano ubheke emabuthweni e-Arbiter. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphambi kwezimpi ezinkulu futhi usebenzise isithwalambiza uma udinga usizo lokusisusa.

halo5-old-bones-1d154487c6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Old Bones" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 9, "Alliance", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela omaka ekamu bese uqedela izingxoxo ezidingekayo ukuze udlulele kumishini elandelayo.

halo5-breakthrough-44a61912b9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Breakthrough" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 10, "Enemy Lines", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sebenza ngemigqa yeSivumelwano, gibela i-Kraken, futhi ucekele phansi umnyombo wayo. Yehla emkhunjini ngaphambi kokuba uwe.

halo5-stormbound-e444b61628.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Stormbound" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 11, "Before the Storm", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Khuluma nabalingiswa abamakiwe ekamu futhi ulandele umgomo wokugcina wokuqhubekela e-Sunaion.

halo5-sentinels-17b0b0779d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sentinels" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, layisha i-Mission 15, "Guardians", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela indlela eya kuma-cores amandla angaphandle futhi uwabhubhise ngaphambi kokuqhubekela ekupheleni komsebenzi.

halo5-drop-a-quarter-b465274307.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack ngamaphoyinti okungenani ayi-10,000.
halo5-drop-a-quarter-b465274307.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Drop A Quarter" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala umsebenzi osuka ku-Score Attack futhi uqedele okungenani ngamaphoyinti angu-10,000. Sebenzisa amaketango ezindondo nobunzima obulawulekayo noma isiphindaphindi se-Skull ukuze ukhuphule isikolo sakho.

halo5-up-for-a-challenge-cf64596fb2.description: Finyelela amaphuzu angu-50,000 ku-Score Attack ngesiphindaphindi se-Skull se-x2 noma ngaphezulu.
halo5-up-for-a-challenge-cf64596fb2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Up For A Challenge" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, khetha I-Score Attack, vula inhlanganisela Yezigebhezi ezinengqikithi yokuphindaphinda Ugebhezi lwe-x2, bese ufinyelela amaphuzu angu-50,000. Gcina amaketanga okubulala ehamba futhi uqedele umsebenzi wokurekhoda amaphuzu.

halo5-party-hearty-734b324062.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack co-op, bonke ababambiqhaza bathole okungenani amaphuzu angu-200,000.
halo5-party-hearty-734b324062.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Party Hearty" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, qala i-Score Attack ngokuhlanganyela. Nikeza umdlali ngamunye izitha ezanele ukuze akhe amaphuzu akhe ngabanye futhi ahlole isamba ngaphambi kokuqeda. Wonke umuntu udinga okungenani amaphuzu angu-200,000 kumishini efanayo.

halo5-the-hare-e04fbdb1f4.description: Hlula isikhathi esilinganiselwe semishini ku-Score Attack.
halo5-the-hare-e04fbdb1f4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Hare" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, kokuthi Score Attack, khetha injongo oyaziyo futhi uhlole isikhathi sayo ngaphambi kokuqaliswa. Landela umzila oyinhloko, weqa ukulwa okungadingekile, futhi uqedele ngaphambi kwesikhathi okuhlosiwe.

halo5-the-tortoise-4ec6397aa1.description: Qedela umkhankaso ku-Score Attack ngamaphoyinti okungenani angu-500,000.
halo5-the-tortoise-4ec6397aa1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Tortoise" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, sebenzisa i-Score Attack bese ukhetha inhloso enezitha eziningi. Khulisa isiphindaphindi samaphuzu sibe sezingeni ongaliqeda, ukubulawa kwamaketango nezindondo, bese uqedela ukugijima ngemva kokufinyelela amaphuzu angu-500,000.

halo5-not-your-first-rodeo-221b413698.description: Iqedele ngempumelelo imidlalo emi-5 ye-Warzone Firefight.
halo5-not-your-first-rodeo-221b413698.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Not Your First Rodeo" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka ulayini we-Warzone Firefight futhi usebenze nethimba lakho ukuze uqedele yonke imizuliswano ngempumelelo. Yakha amandla e-REQ emizuliswaneni yakamuva bese uphinda uze uqophe ukuqeda okuyisihlanu okuyimpumelelo.

halo5-tour-of-duty-4c082a1fcf.description: Qedela umdlalo we-Warzone Firefight kumamephu ayi-6 ahlukile.
halo5-tour-of-duty-4c082a1fcf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tour of Duty" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, faka i-Warzone Firefight futhi uqedele umeshi kumephu ngayinye kwayisithupha ahlukene. Landela ngomkhondo amagama emephu ekuqaleni komdlalo ngamunye ukuze amamephu aphindaphindiwe angabalwa kabili.

halo5-dangerous-game-806e79d250.description: Zuza Ukwehliswa Komphathi Wenganekwane emdlalweni we-Warzone Firefight.
halo5-dangerous-game-806e79d250.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dangerous Game" kokuthi Halo 5: Guardians, umugqa womdlalo we-Warzone Firefight ongazala umphathi weMythic. Londoloza i-REQ esindayo ngomzuliswano wokugcina, gxila kumphathi weMythic lapho ebizwa, futhi uvikele indondo yokwehliswa.

haloinfinite-clocking-in-23ca79782a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Clocking In" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula iphaneli Yezinselele futhi ufunde Inselelo Yansuku zonke yamanje. Dlala umsebenzi ewubalayo kuze kube yilapho umgomo wansuku zonke usuphelile, bese uqeda umdlalo ukuze uqhubeke ubhalise.

haloinfinite-we-have-a-job-for-you-ec8db.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "We Have a Job For You" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula iphaneli Yezinselele, khetha Inselele Yamaviki Onke esebenzayo, bese uhlola imodi yayo edingekayo nenjongo ngaphambi kokubeka ulayini. Qedela okufanayo noma izenzo ezidingekayo ukuze usule.

haloinfinite-humble-beginnings-e4abf2002.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Humble Beginnings" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha i-Battle Pass esebenzayo futhi uzuze i-pass XP eyanele ukuze ufinyelele ileveli yayo elandelayo. Sebenza ezinseleleni ongakwazi ukuqeda izinjongo zakho emdlalweni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-i-m-ready-how-bout-you-4aca.description: Shintsha ukubukeka kwakho kwe-Spartan kumenyu ethi Yenza ngokwezifiso.
haloinfinite-i-m-ready-how-bout-you-4aca.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I'm Ready, How 'Bout You?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula okuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso bese ufaka i-Armor Hall. Khetha isisekelo sezikhali, shintsha enye yezingcezu ezihlomile, futhi usisebenzise ku-Spartan yakho.

haloinfinite-peak-performance-5b1c6ea871.description: Zuza amaphuzu angu-2,000 kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-peak-performance-5b1c6ea871.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Peak Performance" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa imodi yenhloso eyenziwe ngokufanisa futhi unikele ekuthwebuleni, ekubuyiseni, noma ekubambeni eduze nokukhipha kwakho. Hlola isikolo sakho somdlalo bese ufinyelela ku-2,000 ngaphambi kwesikrini semiphumela.

haloinfinite-passion-for-fashion-aa8607d.description: Gqoka into entsha yokwenza ngokwezifiso izikhali.
haloinfinite-passion-for-fashion-aa8607d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Passion for Fashion" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo, vula ingqikithi yezikhali zakho bese uhlomisa ucezu oluhlukile lwezivikelo olungakhiyiwe noma okokunamathela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ucezu luhlomile ngaphambi kokushiya i-Armor Hall.

haloinfinite-which-one-of-us-is-the-mach.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Which One of Us is the Machine?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kokuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso, vula izinketho ze-Personal AI. Khetha imodeli ye-AI evuliwe ehlukile futhi uyihlomise ngaphambi kokuhlehla.

haloinfinite-reporting-for-duty-ee9f812f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Reporting for Duty" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula okuthi Yenza ngokwezifiso futhi uthole i-Spartan ID. Hlela Ithegi Yesevisi, faka ithegi ehlukile evumelekile, bese uyigcina.

haloinfinite-brutality-8666b8bf4f.description: Bulala isitha nge-melee usebenzisa isikhali esinamaphiko kumdlalo owenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-brutality-8666b8bf4f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Brutality" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha isikhali esinamapheshana njenge-Mangler, Skewer, noma i-Ravager ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Yenza isitha sibe buthaka, bese usiqeda ngokuhlasela kwe-melee yaleso sikhali.

haloinfinite-need-a-weapon-131b22fa71.description: Zama into entsha yokwenza ngokwezifiso isikhali.
haloinfinite-need-a-weapon-131b22fa71.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi ""Need a Weapon?"" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Ibhentshi Lezikhali Kokwenza Ngokwezifiso. Khetha isikhali esinengubo evuliwe, intelezi, noma imodeli, bese uhlomisa into bese uqinisekisa ukuthi iyasebenza.

haloinfinite-limited-addition-d0ba6049c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Limited Addition" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qedela ukuphonselwa inselelo kwamasonto onke kuze kuvele inselele yabo yokugcina engavuleki. Funda leyo nselele kuphaneli Yezinselele futhi uqedele inhloso yayo ngesikhathi lisasebenza.

haloinfinite-slaying-with-style-0a521997.description: Zuza Indondo Yenganekwane kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-slaying-with-style-0a521997.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Slaying with Style" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola indondo yeMythic ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Khetha umgomo othile ofana nokudubula okuningi noma ukubulala isikhathi eside futhi usebenzise imodi enabaphikisi abenele noma ama-respawns ukuze uzame.

haloinfinite-you-re-up-rook-e778243c1e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "You're Up, Rook'" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha Uhlu lwadlalwayo Olukumazinga oluvela Kubadlali abaningi bese uqedela okufanayo. Hlala emdlalweni kuze kube isikrini semiphumela.

haloinfinite-peeker-s-disadvantage-94419.description: "Back Smack" isitha esondezwe ngesikhali esinobubanzi kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-peeker-s-disadvantage-94419.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Peeker's Disadvantage" kokuthi Halo Infinite, zulazula isitha usebenzisa isikhali esinesikophu ekwenzeni okufanayo. Linda baze baqonde ku-scope, bese ubashaya ngemuva nge-melee.

haloinfinite-running-laps-16e876f332.description: Thwebula ifulegi kabili kugeyimu yokufanisa i-Capture the Flag.
haloinfinite-running-laps-16e876f332.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Running Laps" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Capture the Flag eyenziwe njengomdlalo, thatha ifulegi lesitha uliyise endaweni yakho yokushaya kabili emdlalweni ofanayo. Cela ozakwenu ukuthi bakuphelezele futhi bakubuyisele ifulegi lakho uma seliphumile.

haloinfinite-customary-3db478745f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Customary" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula igeyimu yangokwezifiso, qala umeshi, futhi uwudlale wonke. Sebenzisa umkhawulo wamaphuzu aphansi kumdlalo omfushane uma uzibekela wena igeyimu.

haloinfinite-just-the-two-of-us-e52a948a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Just the Two of Us" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Okokufundisa kusuka ku-Academy bese ulandela umgomo uye ku-AI yomuntu siqu. Sebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyifinyelele.

haloinfinite-kebab-ecb248d50e.description: Bhubhisa imoto yesitha nge-Skewer kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-kebab-ecb248d50e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Kebab" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni umentshisi, thatha iSkewer bese usisebenzisela ukuthola isibhamu sokuqeda emotweni esetshenziswa isitha. Khomba i-Ghost noma enye imoto elula ukuze uthole impi emfushane.

haloinfinite-that-thing-on-the-left-is-t.description: Hlola ukushayela ukwenza ngokwezifiso imoto entsha.
haloinfinite-that-thing-on-the-left-is-t.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "That Thing on the Left is the Brake" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Vehicle Bay ngokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo. Khetha imoto futhi uhlomise into entsha evuliwe yokwenza ngendlela oyifisayo, bese uyaphuma ukuze uyisebenzise.

haloinfinite-they-see-me-rollin-820ae1f3.description: Caphela umlingani oshayela i-Warthog noma i-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-they-see-me-rollin-820ae1f3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "They See Me Rollin'" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa, sebenzisa ukubuka ngenkathi ulinde ukuzala kabusha ukuze ubuke uzakwenu oshayela i-Warthog noma i-Razorback. Biyela phakathi kozakwenu uze ufike kumshayeli.

haloinfinite-sharpshooter-9daa61199d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sharpshooter" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy, khetha I-Weapon Drills, futhi uqedele ukubhoboza ngesikhali esijwayelekile. Sebenzisa amathagethi okuvula ukuze uthole isigqi ngaphambi kokuhamba phakathi kwemizila.

haloinfinite-doing-your-part-de32d431df.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Doing Your Part" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy bese uqala Okokufundisa. Landela imiyalelo yokudubula nokunyakaza bese uqedela umsebenzi wokugcina.

haloinfinite-all-about-the-grind-e21ed5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "All About the Grind" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha Uhlu lwadlalwayo Olusezingeni bese uqedela uchungechunge lwalo olugcwele lokubekwa kulolo hlu lwadlalwayo. Qeda umeshi ngamunye kuze kube yilapho igeyimu ikunika izinga.

haloinfinite-bomb-returned-7bee9ad87f.description: Xoxisa ibhomu lesitha nge-Repulsor kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-bomb-returned-7bee9ad87f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bomb Returned" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Repulsor ekwenzeni okufanayo. Uma isitha sijikijela ibhomu libheke kuwe, bhekana nalo bese usebenzisa i-Repulsor ngaphambi kokuthi liqhume.

haloinfinite-control-freak-ec56b46453.description: Siza ekuthwebuleni wonke amazoni aholela kumphumela kugeyimu yokulawula Okuphelele eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-control-freak-ec56b46453.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Control Freak" kokuthi Halo Infinite, faka umugqa wokulawula okuphelele okwenziwe ngokulinganisa. Yiba kundawo ngayinye kwezintathu zokuthwebula lapho iqembu lakho likuthatha ngokulandelana okufanayo kwamaphuzu. Zungezisa nozakwenu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba izindawo zangaphambili.

haloinfinite-zone-ranger-d4f2ac462b.description: Vikela izindawo ezi-5 kugeyimu ye-Strongholds eyenziwe ngokulingana.
haloinfinite-zone-ranger-d4f2ac462b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Zone Ranger" kokuthi Halo Infinite, Ezizindeni Eziqinile ezenziwe ngokulingana, yima ezindaweni eziqhudelanayo noma eziyisitha kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho lizithumba. Siza ukuqeda ukuthwebula okuhlanu emdlalweni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-back-to-the-chopper-11dbdea.description: Zuza u-"Splatter" nge-Brute Chopper kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-back-to-the-chopper-11dbdea.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Back to the Chopper" kokuthi Halo Infinite, shayela i-Brute Chopper ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Layisha isitha ngezinyawo, sebenzisa i-boost ukuvala ibanga, futhi usishaye ngaphambili kwemoto ukuze uzuze i-Splatter.

haloinfinite-first-contact-85bab3744a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "First Contact" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Yenza indlela yakho ngomkhumbi oxoshiwe, finyelela ebhulohweni, futhi ubalekele ngemva kokucekela phansi umkhumbi.

haloinfinite-getting-strong-now-32b6a4ed.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Getting Strong Now" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy, khetha Imodi Yokuqeqesha, bese uqalisa iseshini. Linda imephu ukuthi iqede ukulayisha.

haloinfinite-together-again-3627e2a496.description: Hlola i-underbelly ye-Zeta Halo futhi ubuyise isikhali ukuze uguqule isimo salokhu kungqubuzana.
haloinfinite-together-again-3627e2a496.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Together. Again?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Foundation". Landela inhloso ngokusebenzisa isakhiwo Se-Forerunner ukuze ubuyise Isikhali. Qhubeka nomsebenzi kuze kube yilapho ibhala ngokucacile.

haloinfinite-infinity-down-3b361a32f4.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo we-Spartan.
haloinfinite-infinity-down-3b361a32f4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Infinity Down" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Thola i-Spartan Audio Log yangaphambi kwesikhathi futhi usebenzise i-Interact uma ucelwa. Lalela umsindo wayo njengoba usondela endaweni yokulanda.

haloinfinite-two-sides-to-every-story-59.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo exoshiwe.
haloinfinite-two-sides-to-every-story-59.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Two Sides to Every Story" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Warship Gbraakon". Sebenzisa i-Interact kulogi yokuqala yomsindo Ekhishiwe ohlangana nayo. Ividiyo exhunyiwe ibonisa ilogi emkhunjini wempi.
