haloinfinite-ascension-34e7687d6a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ascension" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Foundation". Empini ye-Tremonius, hlubula izihlangu zakhe nge-plasma futhi ubhekane nomonakalo lapho edalulwa. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uvule isikhala uma evala.

haloinfinite-those-wonderful-toys-409c2c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Those Wonderful Toys" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Grappleshot futhi uzidonsele ezindongeni noma amaleji emkhankasweni. Thola indawo ebangeni, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokuyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho ususebenzise ngempumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-hidden-experience-8559d0072.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hidden Experience" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Outpost Tremonius". Vula enye yeziqukathi ezimhlophe ze-UNSC Spartan Core. Eyakho eyokuqala ikumzila we-Outpost Tremonius. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuhlonza indawo ekuyo.

haloinfinite-zeta-b408eaddda.description: Lwela indlela yakho nge-Outpost Tremonius bese uphumela ngaphandle kwe-Zeta Halo.
haloinfinite-zeta-b408eaddda.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Zeta" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Outpost Tremonius". Yilwa endaweni engaphandle futhi ufinyelele phezulu. Sula Abaxoshiwe endaweni okufikela kuyo ngaphambi kokudlulela kunhloso elandelayo.

haloinfinite-dispatches-from-the-front-5.description: Finyelela ilogu yakho yokuqala yomsindo ye-UNSC.
haloinfinite-dispatches-from-the-front-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dispatches From the Front" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha Ilogi Yomsindo ye-UNSC futhi usebenzise i-Interact kuyo. Umhlahlandlela wendawo oxhunyiwe ubonisa ukuthi ungayithola kuphi eyokuqala.

haloinfinite-multi-class-racer-961090b5d.description: Shayela izimoto ezi-4 ezihlukile kumdlalo wenziwe.
haloinfinite-multi-class-racer-961090b5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Multi-class Racer" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kumdlalo owodwa owenziwe umentshisi, thatha isihlalo somshayeli ezimotweni ezine ezihlukene. Sebenzisa imephu enezinhlamvu zezimoto ezimbalwa futhi ushintshe ngokushesha nje lapho usushayele ngayinye.

haloinfinite-a-fellow-of-infinite-jest-b.description: Bulala izitha ezintathu ngebhola kumdlalo we-Oddball owenziwe umentshisi.
haloinfinite-a-fellow-of-infinite-jest-b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A Fellow of Infinite Jest" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Oddball eyenziwe ngokufanisa, thatha ibhola futhi uqedele izitha ezintathu ngokuhlasela kwebhola kumdlalo ofanayo. Linda eduze kwekhava ukuze uvumele izitha ezibuthakathaka zisondele kuwe.

haloinfinite-working-remote-ae89b76cc2.description: Thatha isikhali usebenzisa i-Grappleshot kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-working-remote-ae89b76cc2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Working Remote" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Grappleshot ekwenzeni okufanayo futhi uqondise ngqo esikhalini esixekethile noma i-rack pickup. Shisa ukubambana futhi uyivumele idonsele isikhali ezandleni zakho.

haloinfinite-reclaimer-49b36b3ced.description: Thwebula isisekelo sakho sokuqala sokusebenza phambili.
haloinfinite-reclaimer-49b36b3ced.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Reclaimer" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hamba ku-Forward Operating Base enabantu abaningi, sula abavikeli Abaxoshiwe, bese usebenzisa itheminali ye-FOB ukuze uyithwebule.

haloinfinite-visionary-9b84d4ff11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Visionary" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Tower". Qhubeka ngokusebenzisa i-Tower futhi uthathe Inzwa Yosongo lapho indaba yethula. Yisebenzise ukuveza i-Spartan Killer egqoke izingubo ngesikhathi sokuhlangana.

haloinfinite-outpost-discovery-a2ba530dc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Outpost Discovery" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola ibutho Elikhishiwe ku-TACMAP futhi usule izinhloso zalo ezimakiwe. I-Ransom Keep inketho yangaphambi kwesikhathi. Bhubhisa izisele zikaphethiloli futhi uqedele noma yikuphi okuhlosiwe okusele ngaphambi kokuhamba.

haloinfinite-we-re-on-our-way-319fa3f2b2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "We're On Our Way" kokuthi Halo Infinite, khetha ucingo lokucindezeleka lwe-UNSC ku-TACMAP bese uya eqenjini. Sula izitha ezizungezile, uvikele Amasosha Asolwandle, futhi ulinde ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlenga. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-fallen-3fca855bba.description: Landela isignali ye-UNSC eya endaweni eqinile Exoshiwe ebizwa ngokuthi i-Tower. Thola umthombo. Phuma uphila.
haloinfinite-fallen-3fca855bba.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Fallen" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Tower". Landela isignali yokucindezeleka ungene ku-Tower. Finyelela endaweni yejele, sebenzisa Inzwa Yosongo ukuze ulandelele u-Chak 'Lok, futhi umhlule ukuze uqedele.

haloinfinite-money-in-the-bank-d5d466ad3.description: Finyelela i-Mjolnir Armor Locker yakho yokuqala.
haloinfinite-money-in-the-bank-d5d466ad3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Money in the Bank" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Mjolnir Armor Locker eyodwa. Thwebula i-FOB eseduze ukuze uveze amalokha ku-TACMAP, bese ulandela umaka futhi uxhumane nesiqukathi esiluhlaza.

haloinfinite-headhunter-cc0479736f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Headhunter" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landelela isithonjana esibomvu se-High-Value Target ku-TACMAP. Susa isikhulu esimakiwe futhi usule noma yiziphi izitha ezidingwa ukuhlangana. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-please-shut-up-53ed093cc8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Please Shut Up" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola enye ye-Banished Propaganda Towers, ekhonjwe ngokusakazwa kwayo. Shoot isisekelo sawo kuze kube yilapho umbhoshongo uphuka futhi ukusakaza kuma.

haloinfinite-unearthed-b25c9066ab.description: Vala i-laser yezimayini Ekhishiwe futhi uthole ukufinyelela ku-Conservatory.
haloinfinite-unearthed-b25c9066ab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Unearthed" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Excavation Site". Khubaza okokusebenza okupholisa okuvikela i-laser yezimayini, bese uvala i-laser ukuze uvule indlela eya ku-Conservatory.

haloinfinite-grab-some-cover-876e6c3a8c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Grab Some Cover" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Conservatory". Landela umzila wemishini uze uthole i-Drop Wall. Ihlomise ngesikhethi sezisetshenziswa uma ufuna ukuyizama phakathi nempi elandelayo.

haloinfinite-evasive-maneuvers-a2255ac96.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Evasive Maneuvers" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Conservatory". Qhubeka ngokusebenzisa i-Conservatory uze uthathe i-Thruster. Yihlomise futhi uyisebenzisele ukubalekela ukuhlasela kwesitha.

haloinfinite-takes-one-to-make-one-64c7f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Takes One to Make One" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Ghost emkhankasweni bese uklelisa isitha endaweni evulekile. Sheshisa kubo ngokuthuthukisa ukubulala.

haloinfinite-natural-formation-location-.description: Thola ukufinyelela emhumeni wempango kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-natural-formation-location-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Natural Formation Location Sensation" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Big Team Battle on Fragmentation, thola umnyango womhume oyimpango. Hlanganyela ukuze uqale ukugebenga kwe-Personal AI futhi uvikele indawo yokungena kuze kuvuleke umnyango.

haloinfinite-whip-riding-the-ghost-20d15.description: Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze ugibele i-Ghost yesitha.
haloinfinite-whip-riding-the-ghost-20d15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Whip-Riding the Ghost" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-Ghost enomshayeli wendiza Oxoshiwe, eduze nebanga le-Grappleshot, bese udubula imoto. Ivumele ikudonse ukuze uhlale esihlalweni.

haloinfinite-hunter-killer-bec55ed701.description: Hlula umbhangqwana we-Hunter omiswe phansi kwe-Spire.
haloinfinite-hunter-killer-bec55ed701.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hunter. Killer." kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Spire". Finyelela phansi kwe-Spire futhi unqobe bobabili aba-Hunters. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze uhlukanise eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese uyizungeza futhi uhlose ukuphumela obala kwayo.

haloinfinite-pelican-down-90a211d4a7.description: Vala i-Spire yokuqala futhi umise ukuguqulwa kwe-Zeta ngaphambi kokuba kuphuze kakhulu.
haloinfinite-pelican-down-90a211d4a7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Pelican Down" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Spire". Faka i-Spire yokuqala, finyelela endaweni yayo yokulawula bese uyivala. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot kanye nekhava ngenkathi usebenza ngokuhlangana ngaphakathi.

haloinfinite-one-down-083bdebc80.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "One Down…" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Hamba kwesinye sezibhamu ezintathu ezilwa nendiza bese ulandela izimpawu zaso zenhloso ukuze usiveze futhi usibhubhise. Ukusula isibhamu esisodwa kwanele kule mpumelelo.

haloinfinite-brothers-grim-9bdf030bfc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Brothers Grim" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Ngemva kokubhekana nezibhamu ezilwa nezindiza, ukulwa noHyperius noTovarus. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuhlukanisa ukuhlasela kwabo futhi wehlise okukodwa ngaphambi kokugxila kokunye.

haloinfinite-sick-burn-e19c9b719b.description: Bulala isitha ngesibhamu esikhokhisiwe se-Ravager kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-sick-burn-e19c9b719b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sick Burn" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni okufanayo, bamba i-trigger ye-Ravager ukuze ushaje ishothi, bese uyidedela emhlabathini eduze kwesitha esibuthakathaka. Vumela isibhamu esikhokhisiwe sibaqedele.

haloinfinite-gun-runner-1abfca7c46.description: Yehlisa zonke izibhamu ezintathu eziBanished AA.
haloinfinite-gun-runner-1abfca7c46.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gun Runner" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Pelican Down". Vakashela zonke izibhamu ezintathu ezilwa nezindiza futhi ucekele phansi ngasinye. Sebenzisa imoto noma i-Grappleshot ukuhamba phakathi kwazo. Uma futhi usebenza ngenguqulo yesikhathi yale nselele, hlela umzila wakho ngaphambi kokuthatha isibhamu sokuqala.

haloinfinite-deadeye-3e55b250ff.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Deadeye" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Academy, khetha i-Weapon Drill futhi uhlose ukuthola izinkanyezi ezintathu. Khetha i-low-tier drill yesikhali osiphatha kahle, gcina i-reticle eduze kwethagethi elandelayo, bese ulayisha kabusha phakathi kwamaqembu.

haloinfinite-wait-i-can-throw-those-c708.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wait, I Can Throw Those?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha futhi ujikijele amakhoyili ahlanganisiwe usebenzisa i-Interact uma useduze kweyodwa. Zisebenzise phakathi nezimpi zomkhankaso ukuze uthole umonakalo kalula futhi uqhubeke uze uphonse ama-50.

haloinfinite-light-the-way-da7c69f5f0.description: Finyelela kuma-Beacons, hlanganisa Ukulandelana, futhi uthole ukufinyelela ku-Command Spire.
haloinfinite-light-the-way-da7c69f5f0.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Light the Way" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Sequence". Vakashela i-Beacon ngayinye futhi uxhumane netheminali yayo ukuze uhlanganise Ukulandelana. Landela umaka olandelayo ukuze uvule i-Command Spire.

haloinfinite-what-will-it-take-7f763b2d8.description: Faka i-Nexus futhi ufunde izimfihlo ze-Spires. Ukuthembana kuyinto entekenteke, akunjalo?
haloinfinite-what-will-it-take-7f763b2d8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "What Will It Take?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Nexus". Faka i-Nexus futhi ulwe emagumbini ayo, ume kukhonsoli ngayinye eboniswa umaka wenhloso. Qedela izinjongo ze-Nexus ukuze uvule umgomo olandelayo.

haloinfinite-wars-with-friends-19971eabb.description: Letha namasosha Asolwandle e-UNSC asindisiwe ukuze agibele emishinini eyinhloko.
haloinfinite-wars-with-friends-19971eabb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wars with Friends" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlenga Amasosha Asolwandle noma thola iqembu ku-FOB ethwebuliwe. Donsela imoto enezihlalo zamahhala bese ulinda ukuthi bagibele. Bashayele endaweni yemishini enkulu.

haloinfinite-hear-these-words-205ff7a2f8.description: Ngena ku-Command Spire futhi uqede iNguquko.
haloinfinite-hear-these-words-205ff7a2f8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hear These Words!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "The Command Spire". Sula i-Command Spire, landela indlela eya kuzilawuli zayo, futhi umise iNguquko. Gcina isikhali esiseduze siseduze sabakwa-Sentinels abavalayo.

haloinfinite-together-again-b49c0a482c.description: Umngane usengozini futhi isikhathi siyahamba. Yisikhathi sokubhekana nokwakho okwedlule futhi ulondoloze ikusasa lakho.
haloinfinite-together-again-b49c0a482c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Together. Again." kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Repository". Landela umzila onqamula eNqolobaneni bese ufinyelela kuSikhali. Qhubekela endaweni yokugcina lapho umkhankaso uthuthukela khona.

haloinfinite-new-kid-on-the-block-0a7955.description: Zuza u-"Perfect" nge-VK78 Commando kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-new-kid-on-the-block-0a7955.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "New Kid on the Block" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-VK78 Commando ekwenzeni ukufanisa. Amashothi alawulwa ngumlilo ukuze yonke ichashazi lixhume futhi liqede nge-headshot ukuze uthole i-Perfect.

haloinfinite-eld-aficionado-e1e5489325.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Eld Aficionado" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola I-Artifacts Engaphambili emise okwendandatho ngaphandle ku-Zeta Halo. Yiya endaweni yokusebenzelana esakhiweni bese uyiskena.

haloinfinite-reckoning-5601989fdf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Reckoning" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "House of Reckoning". Ngena eNdlu Yokulandisa futhi usule izimpi zasenkundleni. Phinda unikeze phakathi kwamagagasi futhi ulandele izinhloso ungene ekamelweni elilandelayo.

haloinfinite-legends-aa37de033c.description: Ekugcineni wayeyisosha nje. Ngethemba ukuthi wenze okufanele.
haloinfinite-legends-aa37de033c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Legends" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "House of Reckoning". Qedela ukulwa no-Escharum. Sebenzisa izinsika kanye ne-Grappleshot ukuze ungangeni ebangeni le-melee. Uma isihlangu sakhe sikhuphuka, khomba okokusebenza okumakiwe ukuze umenze abe sengozini futhi.

haloinfinite-set-a-fire-in-your-heart-1d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Set a Fire in Your Heart" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala umkhankaso futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi eyi-14 eyinhloko kuze kufike eHholo Elithulile. Landela omaka bendaba noma nini uma i-TACMAP ivuleka futhi udlulele kumphathi wokugcina ukuze urekhode umkhankaso ngokucacile.

haloinfinite-too-many-goodbyes-4c0071b06.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Too Many Goodbyes" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala okuthi "Silent Auditorium". Yilwa ne-Harbinger futhi usule amagagasi okuqinisa aBanished phakathi kwezigaba zomonakalo. Londoloza amabhomu noma isikhali samandla sezitha eziphuthuma ikhava yakho.

haloinfinite-reaching-out-4f49efac0b.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Reaching Out" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Grappleshot kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-getting-defensive-25cb24de8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Getting Defensive" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Energy Shields kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-sparring-partners-3977b2fd9.description: Shintsha noma iyiphi inketho yemodi yokuqeqesha.
haloinfinite-sparring-partners-3977b2fd9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sparring Partners" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Imodi Yokuqeqesha kusukela ku-Academy, misa isikhashana, futhi uvule Izinketho Zokuqeqesha. Shintsha enye yezilungiselelo, njengobunzima be-bot, bese uqalisa kabusha iseshini.

haloinfinite-enemies-everywhere-465dd574.description: Maka izitha ezi-3+ ngesikhathi esisodwa kumdlalo owenziwe umentshisi.
haloinfinite-enemies-everywhere-465dd574.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Enemies Everywhere!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, linda kuze kube yilapho abaphikisi abathathu sebesondelene ngokubuka kwakho ekwenzeni okufanayo, bese usebenzisa okokufaka kuka-Mark eqenjini. Yilwa kusuka endaweni ephakeme ukuze uthole umbono ocacile wabaphikisi abambalwa ngesikhathi esisodwa.

haloinfinite-bare-your-fangs-a2361cbe1a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bare Your Fangs" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ube Okuvamile futhi uqedele konke okushiwo yizindaba ezingu-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-get-the-popcorn-e3fb9165fc.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Get the Popcorn" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula Ithiyetha, khetha okufanayo emlandweni wakho wakamuva, bese uqala ukudlala. Ivumele ilayishe ize ifike lapho ungalawula khona ukurekhoda.

haloinfinite-headstrong-0632bd68a7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Headstrong" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola futhi uqoqe noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe. Sebenzisa isithwebuli uma uzwa isiqephu somsindo se-Skull, bese ulandela ividiyo uma uyilanda.

haloinfinite-wanna-have-a-catch-d2e10409.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wanna Have a Catch?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa ama-Plasma noma ama-Spike Grenades futhi uhlasele izitha eziqondile ukuze amabhomu anamathele. Vala ibanga kuqala ukuze ukujikijela kube lula, futhi uqhubeke uze ubambe izitha ezingu-50.

haloinfinite-watt-say-you-bf059d801a.description: Zuza u-"Chain Reaction" nge-Shock Rifle kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-watt-say-you-bf059d801a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Watt Say You?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sebenzisa i-Shock Rifle ekwenzeni okufanayo. Shutha eduze kwezitha ezihlanganiswe ngokuqinile ngokwanele ukuze ugesi u-arc, futhi uthole ukubulala nge-arc ukuze uthole i-Chain Reaction.

haloinfinite-resurgency-44d21e773d.description: Thwebula zonke izisekelo ezitholakalayo zokuSebenza Phambili.
haloinfinite-resurgency-44d21e773d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Resurgency" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sula futhi uthwebule Isisekelo SokuSebenza Phambili esimakiwe ku-TACMAP. Sebenzisa itheminali ngayinye ye-FOB ngemva kokuhlula abavikeli bayo futhi uhlole noma yiziphi izimpawu zokuthwebula ezisele.

haloinfinite-bunker-buster-35e675adb1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bunker Buster" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qedela zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshiwe. Yenza kusebenze indawo ngayinye yangaphandle ku-TACMAP, landela omaka benhloso yasendaweni, futhi uhlale kuze kuvele isaziso sokuqeda.

haloinfinite-one-shot-top-mid-54c0319171.description: Maka isitha esitholakala kokuthi "Top Mid" kugeyimu eyenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-one-shot-top-mid-54c0319171.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "One Shot, Top Mid" ku-Halo Infinite, e-Arena eyenziwe ngomentshisi, linda isitha sime maphakathi nendawo engenhla yemephu nge-Top Mid callout, efana ne-Aquarius. Khomba isitha futhi usebenzise Maka. Bheka i-callout ukuze uqinisekise indawo.

haloinfinite-bloodstars-bane-aee2119dab.description: Susa konke okuhlosiwe kwenani eliphezulu okungu-15.
haloinfinite-bloodstars-bane-aee2119dab.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bloodstars' Bane" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landelela phansi konke Okuqondiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu Okuyi-15 Ku-TACMAP. Sula ukuhlangana ngakunye futhi uhlole ukuthi isithonjana saso esiqondiwe simakwe njengokuphelele ngaphambi kokukhetha okulandelayo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-nosebleed-b3a05ec122.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Nosebleed" kokuthi Halo Infinite, gibela esiqongweni sentaba esiphezulu esibheke endaweni emaphakathi ye-Zeta Halo. I-Chain Grappleshot idonsa ubuso bedwala futhi ime esiqongweni.

haloinfinite-battle-tested-f5304255e2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Battle Tested" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha i-Battle Pass ofuna ukusebenza ngayo njengesebenzayo. Zuza i-XP kumameshi nezinselele uze uqede isigaba sayo sokugcina.

haloinfinite-skyhook-shot-24c26160a4.description: "Grapplejack" isitha endizayo imoto kumdlalo wenziwe umeshisi.
haloinfinite-skyhook-shot-24c26160a4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Skyhook Shot" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Grappleshot ekwenzeni okufanayo futhi ufinyelele isitha esishayela imoto endizayo. Khomba endizeni, dubula impi, futhi uyivumele ikudonsele ekuduneni.

haloinfinite-all-seeing-i-a66f58289f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "All-Seeing I" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa Inzwa Yosongo futhi uyivulele endaweni eseduze emkhankasweni. Thola udonga oluseceleni kokulwa, linda ukupholisa umoya phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokulusebenzisa uze ube nokusetshenziswa okuyimpumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-no-one-left-behind-b8ee74af.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No One Left Behind" kokuthi Halo Infinite, phendula ucingo ngalunye lwe-UNSC ku-TACMAP futhi ubulale Abaxoshiweyo abasongela iqembu. Hlola izimpawu zokucindezeleka ezisele uma usuqedile. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-do-you-even-gift-b40cf80b1c.description: Dedela Isikhali Samandla sozakwethu kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-do-you-even-gift-b40cf80b1c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Do You Even Gift?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekwenzeni okufanayo, thatha Isikhali Samandla njengesiqalisi se-Rocket noma i-Skewer. Sebenzisa okokufaka kwe-Drop Weapon eduze nozakwethu futhi ubavumele bakuthathe. Hlola izibopho zakho kuqala uma okokufaka kungabelwe.

haloinfinite-thrusters-on-full-183d3f2d5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Thrusters On Full" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa we-Thruster kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-big-brother-725cb977d7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Big Brother" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa Wenzwa Yosongo kuze kube yilapho usuvulwe wonke umugqa.

haloinfinite-impervious-cf81115d5d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Impervious" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa ama-Spartan Cores ezitsheni ezimhlophe emkhankasweni. Vula ithebhu ethi Thuthukisa futhi uthenge isigaba ngasinye kumugqa Wodonga Oludedelayo kuze kube yilapho wonke umugqa usuvuliwe.

haloinfinite-augmented-e504c528ce.description: Zuza izinkanyezi ezi-3 kuma-5 Tier 3 Weapon Drill.
haloinfinite-augmented-e504c528ce.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Augmented" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula i-Academy Weapon Drills bese ukhetha i-Tier 3. Zuza amaphuzu ezinkanyezi ezintathu ngezikhali ezinhlanu ezahlukene, uqale ngezikhali ububanzi bazo nesikhathi sokulayisha kabusha owazi kangcono.

haloinfinite-straight-to-the-bank-f6da14.description: Idiphozithi Imbewu Yamandla emi-5 kumdlalo we-Stockpile owenziwe ngomentshisi.
haloinfinite-straight-to-the-bank-f6da14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Straight to the Bank" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kusitoko esenziwe njengomdlalo, phatha Imbewu Yamandla uye ezindaweni zokugcina imali zeqembu lakho. Idiphozithi emihlanu kugeyimu efanayo, usebenzisa ozakwenu ukuze uthole ikhava emzileni obuyayo.

haloinfinite-secret-stash-4a75046f07.description: Beka into endaweni yokugcina ye-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-secret-stash-4a75046f07.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Secret Stash" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa, letha into esekelwe njengeMbewu Yamandla ngemuva kwe-Razorback. Sebenzisa umyalo wesitoreji lapho ukuze uwubeke.

haloinfinite-fight-hard-die-well-6414517.description: Qedela yonke imikhankaso eyinhloko yobunzima bobuqhawe.
haloinfinite-fight-hard-die-well-6414517.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Fight Hard, Die Well" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ube Obuqhawe futhi uqedele konke okushiwo yizindaba eziyi-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-run-rabbit-run-6d44b795b2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Run Rabbit, Run" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Thruster futhi uyenze isebenze ukuze igijime emkhankasweni. Thola indawo evulekile, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke uyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho usukwazi ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo okungu-50.

haloinfinite-aegis-fate-bc3723b083.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Aegis Fate" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Drop Wall futhi uyisebenzise emkhankasweni. Thola indawo eyisicaba, linda ukupholisa phansi phakathi kokwenza kusebenze, futhi uqhubeke nokuyisebenzisa kuze kube yilapho ususebenzise ngempumelelo izikhathi ezingu-50.

haloinfinite-medic-bb8ed16537.description: Vuselela ababambisene nabo abangu-3 emzuliswaneni we-Attrition/Ekuqedweni kumdlalo owenziwe ngokwezifiso.
haloinfinite-medic-bb8ed16537.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "MEDIC!" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala umjikelezo we-Attrition noma wokuqeda ekwenzeni ukufanisa noma Umdlalo Wangokwezifiso. Uma ozakwethu ephansi futhi evuseleleka, bamba i-Interact endaweni yakhe yokuvuselela. Qedela ukuvuselela okuthathu emzuliswaneni ofanayo.

haloinfinite-armory-amore-e7eadc6980.description: Finyelela kuwo wonke ama-34 Mjolnir Armor Lockers.
haloinfinite-armory-amore-e7eadc6980.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Armory Amore" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula wonke ama-34 Mjolnir Armor Lockers. Thwebula ama-FOB aseduze ukuze uveze izithonjana futhi uphawule isifunda ngasinye ku-TACMAP njengoba uvula amalokha ayo.

haloinfinite-bring-shiela-home-safely-41.description: Thola i-Scorpion yonke indlela eya "House" ngaphandle kokuthi iqhume.
haloinfinite-bring-shiela-home-safely-41.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bring Shiela Home Safely" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-The Road, shayela i-Scorpion kusukela ekuqaleni komzila oya eNdlini Yokubika. Bhubhisa izinsongo ezinzima ezivela ebangeni elide futhi wenze ikhophi yasenqolobaneni uma izitha zisondela. Finyelela endlini ngethangi lokuqala liphelele.

haloinfinite-mjolnir-master-3b3822f030.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mjolnir Master" kokuthi Halo Infinite, vula zonke iziqukathi ze-Spartan Core. Thwebula ama-FOB ukuze umake ukuthatha okuseduze futhi uhlole ohambweni lomkhankaso wanoma yiziphi iziqukathi ozigejile. Sebenzisa i-Mission Replay ukuze uhlanze.

haloinfinite-haruspis-387fc8e1c3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Haruspis" kokuthi Halo Infinite, skena izindandatho eziyisikhombisa zaManduleli. Sebenzisa izindawo ezixhunyiwe ukumaka ngayinye ku-TACMAP futhi uxhumane neringi ngaphambi kokudlulela phambili.

haloinfinite-passing-the-gas-a9e99ad531.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Passing the Gas" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-Brute eduze ne-Grunt bese uyilinda ukuze iphakamise i-Grunt. Landelela i-Grunt ngokuphonsa futhi ubulale leyo Grunt ngaphambi kokuthi ibaleke.

haloinfinite-make-a-little-more-noise-81.description: Thatha isikhali samandla endaweni yezikhali Okokufundisa.
haloinfinite-make-a-little-more-noise-81.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Make a Little More Noise" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Isifundo se-Academy futhi ufinyelele indawo yokugcina izikhali. Sebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uthathe isikhali samandla endaweni yaso ngenkathi usegumbini.

haloinfinite-a-true-test-of-legends-e9bd.description: Qedela yonke imikhankaso eyinhloko ebunzimeni be-Legendary.
haloinfinite-a-true-test-of-legends-e9bd.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A True Test of Legends" kokuthi Halo Infinite, setha umkhankaso ku-Legendary futhi uqedele konke ukuthunywa kwezindaba ezingu-14. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukuze uphume ekulweni obala futhi uqoqe ama-Spartan Cores ukuze uthole isihlangu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemishini phakathi kwezinhloso zendaba.

haloinfinite-know-your-enemy-3d8841308c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Know Your Enemy" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa wonke Amalogi Omsindo Akhishiwe. Hlola izinto zokubala zenjongo nezindawo ku-TACMAP futhi usebenzise Ukudlala kabusha Kwezinjongo nganoma yini egejiwe ngaphakathi kwamaleveli endaba.

haloinfinite-catacomb-3d90a03ffb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Catacomb" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa zonke izingebhezi ezifihliwe ezingu-12. Sebenzisa izahluko kuvidiyo ukuze usebenze indawo eyodwa ngesikhathi, futhi usebenzise i-Mission Replay ukuze ubuyisele ama-Skulls ngaphakathi kwamazinga ezindaba aqediwe.

haloinfinite-forza-veloce-b89a3a3011.description: Qedela yonke imisebenzi eyi-14 eyinhloko ngaphansi kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili.
haloinfinite-forza-veloce-b89a3a3011.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Forza Veloce" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala umkhankaso kokuthi Easy futhi ugxile kuphela ezinjongweni zendaba ensomi. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot nemoto isikhathi eside, futhi uqedele ohambweni abangu-14 ngesikhathi esiphelele esingaphansi kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili.

haloinfinite-party-bus-16b1d6417e.description: Zuza "Mount Up" nge-Razorback kugeyimu eyenziwe ngokufanisa.
haloinfinite-party-bus-16b1d6417e.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Party Bus" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngena esihlalweni somshayeli we-Razorback ekwenzeni umentshisi bese ushaya uphondo. Linda ozakwenu ukuthi bagcwalise zonke izihlalo ezintathu ngenkathi ucingo lusebenza ukuze uthole i-Mount Up.

haloinfinite-off-the-air-f9e9b98d85.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Off the Air" kokuthi Halo Infinite, bhubhisa yonke imibhoshongo engu-40 Exoshiwe Ye-Propaganda. Lalela ukusakaza kwabo, sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze uthole imibhoshongo engabonakali kumephu yakho, futhi uhlole isibalo sesifunda ngasinye njengoba uya.

haloinfinite-canon-collector-a95046c9e7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Canon Collector" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa yonke ilogi yomsindo ye-UNSC. Lalela inkomba yelogi eseduze, sebenzisa i-Interact, bese ubheka izinto zokubala zesifunda nezemishini ku-TACMAP ukuze uthole okurekhodiwe okungekho.

haloinfinite-who-is-max-valor-f7c071233d.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Who is Max Valor?" kokuthi Halo Infinite, sula imisebenzi yokuzithandela eklomelisa i-Valor. Sebenza ngezindawo Ezikhishiwe, izingcingo ze-UNSC, kanye ne-Propaganda Towers, bese uqhathanisa izibalo zemisebenzi eqediwe yesifunda ngasinye. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rubicon-protocol-351f4cb060.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rubicon Protocol" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa yonke ilogi yomsindo ye-Spartan. Hlola ukuqhubeka ku-TACMAP, uyiqhathanise nezindawo zevidiyo, futhi usebenzise i-Mission Replay ukuthola izindawo zendaba ezingekho.

haloinfinite-greased-lightning-f0dfb5275.description: Qedela i-Movement Yard ngaphansi kwamasekhondi angu-25.
haloinfinite-greased-lightning-f0dfb5275.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Greased Lightning" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala Okokufundisa futhi ufinyelele Igceke Lokunyakaza. Shelelisela esifundweni, gxuma izithiyo ngaphandle kokuma, bese uslayida engxenyeni ephansi. Zama futhi kusukela ekuqaleni kwesifundo kuze kube isikhathi singaphansi kwamasekhondi angu-25.

haloinfinite-gatecrasher-5cb9b86402.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gatecrasher" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngendlela ye-Auditorium, dlulela emgomweni wokwephula ngokushesha. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot ukweqa izikhala futhi ugweme izimpi ozikhethele ukuze ufinyelele iphuzu lokwephulwa kwemithetho ngaphansi kwemizuzu emithathu.

haloinfinite-headmaster-f1cb7bbddb.description: Qedela yonke imisebenzi eyinhloko ku-Legendary ngawo wonke ama-Skulls asebenzayo.
haloinfinite-headmaster-f1cb7bbddb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Headmaster" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qoqa zonke izingebhezi eziyi-12 ngaphambi kokuqala ukugijima kwenganekwane. Qala umkhankaso omusha ngayo yonke i-Skull enikwe amandla ukuze yonke imisebenzi emikhulu ibalwe. Gcina izihlangu zifakwe i-melee uma i-Black Eye isebenza futhi usebenzise izinhlamvu ezingenamkhawulo ze-Bandana ukuze ugcine ingcindezi ezitheni.

haloinfinite-stick-around-da20343fe2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Stick Around" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thola i-skewer yempi ye-Tremonius. Sebenzisa esinye isikhali ukukhumula izihlangu zakhe uma kudingeka, bese uklelisa ukushaya kokugcina nge-Skewer.

haloinfinite-more-than-he-bargained-for-.description: Nqoba i-War Chief Escharum ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa izihlangu zakho ngokugcwele.
haloinfinite-more-than-he-bargained-for-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "More Than He Bargained For" kokuthi Halo Infinite, yilwa no-Escharum kusukela embozweni futhi usebenzise i-Grappleshot ukuze udale ibanga lapho egijima. Uma isihlangu sakho siba phansi, nqamula umugqa wokubona futhi usivumele sishajwe kabusha. Mehlule ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yisihlangu sonke.

haloinfinite-inseparable-57538e974f.description: Ngokubambisana, bulala u-Hunter nomfowabo oyisibopho phakathi kwamasekhondi amathathu omunye komunye.
haloinfinite-inseparable-57538e974f.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Inseparable" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, yabela umdlali oyedwa u-Hunter ngababili kumdlali ngamunye. Yenza kube buthaka kokubili, bese ubiza uma ngayinye seyilungile futhi ubeke amagalelo okuqeda phakathi nemizuzwana emithathu enye kwenye. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-hunting-party-01d3ed3333.description: Ngokubambisana, susa konke Okuhlosiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu Okukhishiwe kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-hunting-party-01d3ed3333.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hunting Party" kokuthi Halo Infinite, joyina umkhankaso wokubambisana futhi umake Okukhonjiwe Kwenani Eliphezulu ku-TACMAP. Sula konke okuyi-15 njengeqembu futhi uhlole isithonjana ngasinye ukuze siqedwe ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-first-responders-9df67109f5.description: Ngokubambisana, phendula zonke izingcingo ze-UNSC zokucindezeleka kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-first-responders-9df67109f5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "First Responders" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, hamba kuwo wonke umaka wokucindezeleka we-UNSC. Sula izitha ezibeka iqembu engozini bese ulinda isaziso sokuqeda ngaphambi kokudlulela kwesilandelayo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-wardens-of-zeta-ae6f7d7c89.description: Ngokuhlanganyela, qedelani zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshwayo kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-wardens-of-zeta-ae6f7d7c89.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wardens of Zeta" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, sulani zonke izindawo eziyisikhombisa Ezixoshiwe ndawonye. Landela izinjongo zendawo zesikhungo ngasinye bese uhlola i-TACMAP ukuze uthole izindawo eziphumayo ezisabonakala njengezingakaqedwa. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-vintage-fisticuffs-2ae5d298.description: Ku-Nexus, bulala ipheya ye-Hunter ngamagalelo okugcina e-melee.
haloinfinite-vintage-fisticuffs-2ae5d298.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Vintage Fisticuffs" ku-Halo Infinite, ku-Nexus, gcina aba-Hunter bephila kuze kube yilapho ubaqeda nge-melee. Yenza buthaka ngemuva, bese uvala eyodwa ngenkathi ilulama ekuhlaselweni futhi ihlasele i-melee yokubulala. Phinda wenze okunye.

haloinfinite-what-s-rightfully-ours-647a.description: Ngokuhlanganyela, thwebula zonke Izisekelo Zokusebenza Phambili kunoma ibuphi ubunzima.
haloinfinite-what-s-rightfully-ours-647a.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "What's Rightfully Ours" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kumkhankaso wokubambisana, sula yonke i-FOB futhi usebenzise ikhonsoli yokuthwebula. Qhathanisa omaka bakho abaqediwe be-TACMAP ukuze uthole noma iyiphi i-FOB esengaphansi kolawulo Lokuxoshwa. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-turnabout-is-fair-play-0faf.description: Bulala iNduna eyodwa bese usebenzisa i-turret yakhe ukubulala enye eNqolobaneni.
haloinfinite-turnabout-is-fair-play-0faf.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Turnabout is Fair Play" kokuthi Halo Infinite, Endaweni Yokugcina, bulala iNhloko eyodwa bese ucosha i-turret ewisayo. Phatha i-turret kwenye iNduna futhi uyisebenzisele ukuletha igalelo lokugcina.

haloinfinite-air-raid-9044774975.description: Ngokubambisana, bulala izitha eziyi-100 ngenkathi bonke abadlali begibele izimoto zomoya.
haloinfinite-air-raid-9044774975.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Air Raid" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ekuhlanganyeleni komkhankaso, nikeza wonke umdlali indawo endizeni. Hlala emoyeni ngenkathi i-fireteam ibulala izitha ngezansi, futhi uqhubeke kuze kube yilapho inani lokubulala elingu-100 nabo bonke abadlali abagibeleyo. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rapid-unscheduled-disassemb.description: Bhubhisa womabili amaPhantom ngaphambi kokuthi asuke e-Outpost Tremonius.
haloinfinite-rapid-unscheduled-disassemb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rapid Unscheduled Disassembly" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ku-Outpost Tremonius, qoqa izikhali ezinzima ngaphambi kokucupha ama-Phantom. Gxilisa umlilo ku-dropship ngayinye njengoba ingena futhi ibhubhise yomibili ngaphambi kokuthi ihambe.

haloinfinite-it-really-does-beat-everyth.description: Susa zonke izitha ku-South Beacon nge-Scorpion Tank.
haloinfinite-it-really-does-beat-everyth.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "It Really Does Beat Everything" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Scorpion uye kuBeacon waseNingizimu Ngokulandelana. Hlala ethangini futhi usebenzise izikhali zayo ukuqeda zonke izitha kuBeacon ngaphambi kokuxhumana nenhloso yayo.

haloinfinite-conservation-of-momentum-c4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Conservation of Momentum" kokuthi Halo Infinite, qala i-Conservatory kusukela ekuqaleni bese uqonda ngqo ezinhlosweni. Sebenzisa i-Grappleshot emaphaseji, weqa izimpi ezingavimbeli ukuqhubeka, futhi uqede ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-15.

haloinfinite-workplace-safety-violation-.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Workplace Safety Violation" kokuthi Halo Infinite, kuyilapho i-laser yezimayini eNdaweni Yokumbiwa isebenza, yima ohlangothini olukude lwe-beam kusukela esitheni. Yiyengele ekuweleni ugongolo futhi uvumele i-laser ithole ukubulala.

haloinfinite-out-with-a-bang-fb686ea521.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Out with a Bang" ku-Halo Infinite, ku-The Tower, yenza buthaka i-Chak 'Lok ngezikhali zakho. Sebenzisa Inzwa Yosongo ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuphi, bese umnamathisele nge-Plasma Grenade ukuze aqede.

haloinfinite-spire-stalker-14a4edb56c.description: Bulala izitha ezingama-40 nge-Stalker Rifle ku-Command Spire.
haloinfinite-spire-stalker-14a4edb56c.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Spire Stalker" kokuthi Halo Infinite, letha i-Stalker Rifle ku-Command Spire futhi uyisebenzisele ukuqeda izitha ezingu-40 lapho. Londoloza amashothi ayo ukuze uthole amahithi ahlanzekile futhi uthathe okushintshile noma ugcwalise kabusha lapho kutholakala.

haloinfinite-cow-catcher-96fb7f7003.description: Ngokubambisana, splatter izitha ezingu-50 ngenkathi ugibele imoto nomunye umdlali.
haloinfinite-cow-catcher-96fb7f7003.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Cow Catcher" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana, faka abadlali ababili emotweni efanayo. Sebenzisa umfutho womshayeli ukugijima phezu kwezitha endaweni evulekile futhi ugcine bobabili abadlali begibele uze ube nama-splatters angama-50. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-gruesome-twosome-22397ae2eb.description: Ngokusebenzisana, bulala izitha ezingu-50 ngenkathi ugibele iMongoose nomunye umdlali.
haloinfinite-gruesome-twosome-22397ae2eb.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gruesome Twosome" kokuthi Halo Infinite, faka abadlali ababili kuMongoose nihlanganyele. Vumela umgibeli adubule ngenkathi umshayeli egcina iMongoose inganyakazi. Hlala emkhunjini ngokubulala okungu-50. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-keep-it-steady-b6861028ef.description: Bulala izitha ezi-5 nge-Sniper Rifle emotweni. Bonke abadlali abagibele inqubekelaphambili yabelana ngemoto.
haloinfinite-keep-it-steady-b6861028ef.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Keep It Steady" kokuthi Halo Infinite, thatha i-Sniper Rifle uye esihlalweni semoto ongakwazi ukudubula kuso futhi uhlale phakathi kwayo ngenkathi uthola ukubulala okuhlanu ngaso. Noma ubani ogibele imoto efanayo wabelana ngenqubekelaphambili. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-rolling-thunder-267c235873.description: Bulala izitha ezi-5 nge-Gravity Hammer emotweni. Bonke abadlali abagibele inqubekelaphambili yabelana ngemoto.
haloinfinite-rolling-thunder-267c235873.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rolling Thunder" kokuthi Halo Infinite, hlomisa i-Gravity Hammer bese ugibela isihlalo semoto esivumela ukuhlasela. Shayela eduze kwamaqembu futhi usebenzise isando esivela esihlalweni ukuze uthole ukubulala okuhlanu. Abadlali abagibele imoto efanayo babelana ngenqubekelaphambili. Izithombe ezixhunyanisiwe ze-co-op zinokuphawula kweSpanishi.

haloinfinite-mix-things-up-3d3e44e247.description: Thola okungenani ukubulala okukodwa ngaso sonke isikhali esitholakalayo kanye namabhomu emkhunjini oBanished.
haloinfinite-mix-things-up-3d3e44e247.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mix Things Up" kokuthi Halo Infinite, dlala i-Warship Gbraakon futhi usebenzise isikhali ngasinye nohlobo lwamabhomu olutholakala emkhunjini ukuze uthole ukubulala. Qala ngokulayisha kwakho, bese ushintshanisa izikhali ukuze uthole amaconsi ezitha kanye nama-pickup. Landelela uhlobo ngalunye ngaphambi kokushiya umkhumbi.

haloinfinite-you-me-same-page-8b27cf2ffd.description: Ngokusebenzisana, cekela phansi yonke imibhoshongo epholile e-Dig Site phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-60 ukusuka kwenye.
haloinfinite-you-me-same-page-8b27cf2ffd.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "You, Me, Same Page" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana ku-Dig Site, veza imibhoshongo yokupholisa kuqala. Hlukanisa ithimba lakho phakathi kokuhlosiwe, lilungiselele ukuqeda ngokushesha, futhi uwalahle wonke phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-60 wokuqala.

haloinfinite-controlled-demolition-27346.description: Ngokusebenzisana, bhubhisa ama-Fuel Silos amane phakathi nemizuzwana emihlanu ku-Ransom Keep noma ku-Forge of Teash.
haloinfinite-controlled-demolition-27346.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Controlled Demolition" kokuthi Halo Infinite, ngokubambisana e-Ransom Keep noma i-Forge of Teash, veza omane ama-Fuel Silos kuqala futhi uwenze buthaka ngaphandle kokuwacekela phansi. Yabela okuqondiwe, ubale wehle, futhi ucekele phansi konke okune phakathi kwamasekhondi amahlanu.

haloinfinite-wolves-at-the-doors-c67546b.description: Ngokusebenzisana, yehlisa wonke amasango amathathu phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-15 elinye nelinye e-Riven Gate.
haloinfinite-wolves-at-the-doors-c67546b.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wolves at the Doors" kokuthi Halo Infinite, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Ngokusebenzisana e-Riven Gate, sula izitha ezizungeze izilawuli ezintathu kuqala.
2. Beka isidlali kusilawuli ngasinye esitholakalayo noma hlela umzila omfushane phakathi kwemibili.
3. Qala ukubala wehle bese wehlisa wonke amasango amathathu ngemizuzwana eyi-15.

halowarsde-58.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Meet Sergeant Forge" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 1, "Alpha Base", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula izindawo zesitha eduze kwendlela, khulula Amasosha Asolwandle avaleleke, futhi usebenzise ama-Warthogs akho kanye nebutho elihamba ngezinyawo ukuze uthathe kabusha i-Alpha Base.

halowarsde-75.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Halo Undergraduate" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula umcimbi wakho wokuqala womugqa wesikhathi ngokuthuthukela emkhankasweni kanye noQoboniso nokuqoqa amabhokisi Amnyama. Ekuqaleni, thatha Ibhokisi Elimnyama ku-Alpha Base ukuze uthole indlela eqondile yokuvula umugqa wesikhathi. Hlola umugqa wesikhathi kumenyu ukuze ubone ukuthi yini evuliwe.

halowarsde-59.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Build for Success" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 2, "Relic Approach", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Yakha esisekelweni sakho, bese uphushela ngasesandleni ngokusebenzisa ukuzivikela kweSivumelwano. Sula imibhoshongo nezimoto ngaphambi kokuthumela izinsana phambili.

halowarsde-3.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide kunoma iyiphi injongo.
halowarsde-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Momma's Boy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala kabusha i-Alpha Base futhi uhlose ukuqeda ngokushesha ngokulahleka kweyunithi okumbalwa. Sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ku-Grunts ngokubulala okusheshayo. Hlola isikrini semiphumela yegolide futhi usebenzise ukugijima okuxhunyiwe ukuze ubone ukuthi sakha kanjani isikolo.

halowarsde-60.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Smash and Grab" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 3, "Relic Interior", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Thola ku-Forge no-Anders, bese ubaphelezela ubuye ngesalela. Sebenzisa izilawuli zebhuloho futhi unamathele kumphelezeli uze ufinyelele ekukhishweni.

halowarsde-61.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "High Class Escort" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 4, "Arcadia City", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela imikhumbi ephumayo futhi usule amasosha eSivumelwano emizileni yabantu. Gxilisa ukuzivikela kwakho nxazonke zokuthutha ngaphansi komlilo.

halowarsde-62.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Patience IS a Virtue" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 5, "Arcadia Outskirts", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Buyela endaweni eyisisekelo, wakhe ibutho kanye nama-turrets, futhi ubambe isikhundla sakho ngokuhlaselwa kweSivumelwano.

halowarsde-63.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Great Form!" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 6, "Dome of Light", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Baphelezele oRhino baye ezindaweni zabo ezimakiwe zokudubula. Gcina amayunithi asekelayo eduze kukaRhino ngamunye kuze kube yilapho idome lehla.

halowarsde-64.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dancing with the Beam Queen" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 7, "Scarab", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Yakha ibutho esisekelweni bese wehlisa iScarab. Gcina amayunithi ecacile kugongolo lwawo olushanelayo lapho umiswa kabusha.

halowarsde-65.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Saving the Parade" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 8, "Ander's Signal", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Landela isignali, vikela Izindlovu, futhi uvikele amasosha akho ahamba ngezinyawo njengoba uphusha kuZamcolo.

halowarsde-56.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Alas, Poor Andrew Thomas" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Alpha Base bese uqedela umgomo webhonasi wokubulala ama-Grunts angu-100. Uma ugebhezi luvela, hambisa iyunithi endaweni yayo bese uyiqoqa ngaphambi kokuthi umgomo uphele. Ividiyo ikhombisa ukulandwa.

halowarsde-66.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Staving Off the Infection" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 9, "The Flood", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Misa isisekelo sakho, udlule emakoloni kaZamcolo aseduze, futhi ugxilise amasosha akho esakhiweni esimaphakathi sikaZamcolo.

halowarsde-67.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Evacuation of the Fittest" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 10, "Shield World", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Buyisa ama-platoon ahlakazekile futhi ubuyisele abasindile endaweni yokuphuma ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi.

halowarsde-68.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Most Valuable Deck Hand" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 11, "Cleansing", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Sula uZamcolo emphemeni yoMoya woMlilo. Hambisa amasosha kude nensimu yokuhlanza lapho isondela endaweni yawo.

halowarsde-69.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "She’s my Fixer Upper" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 12, "Repairs", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Thumela amayunithi e-Cyclops ukuze alungise umgogodla wamandla futhi uwavikele ezitheni ezisesiteki kuze kuqedwe ukulungiswa.

halowarsde-70.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A Means to an End" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 13, "Beachhead", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela indawo yokuhlala, sungula isisekelo sakho, futhi usebenze ngeSivumelwano noZamcolo endleleni eya emgomweni omakiwe.

halowarsde-71.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Signed, Sealed, Delivered" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 14, "Reactor", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Vikela Indlovu edonsa i-reactor futhi usule ingxenye ngayinye yomzila ngaphambi kokuhambisa i-reactor ukhuphuke.

halowarsde-72.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Forging a Way to History" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, layisha i-Mission 15, "Escape", kunoma ibuphi ubunzima. Hlukanisa ibutho lakho phakathi kwamaphoyinti okulawula futhi wenze kusebenze izilawuli zeminyango njengoba i-mission iqondisa. Gcina abavikeli ezindaweni ezivuliwe kuze kuvuleke ukuphuma.

halowarsde-40.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "N00b n0 M0r3" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, faka indawo yokwamukela abantu abaningi futhi udlale umdlalo ogcwele kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho liwina. Bheka ukuvuleka kusenesikhathi ukuze wakhe ibutho lakho, bese uhlanganisa ukuhlasela nanoma yibaphi abambisene nabo.

halowarsde-32.description: Wina umdlalo we-Skirmish we-3v3 nge-2 AI Allies.
halowarsde-32.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "My Virtual Friends Love Me" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha i-3v3 Skirmish futhi ufake abadlali be-AI kuzo zombili izikhala ezihlangene. Gcina izisekelo zabo ziphephile ngenkathi iqembu lakho lihlasela uhlangothi oluphikisayo. Qeda umdlalo ngokuwina.

halowarsde-41.description: Wina futhi uthole amaphuzu aphezulu kakhulu kumdlalo womphakathi.
halowarsde-41.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "So Lonely At the Top" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, joyina umdlalo osesidlangalaleni futhi uqedele ohlangothini oluwinile ngesikolo somdlali esiphezulu kakhulu. Nweba umnotho wakho kusenesikhathi, sebenzisa amayunithi akho ekulweni esikhundleni sokuwagcina engenzi lutho, futhi uwagcine phakathi kokuhlasela.

halowarsde-33.description: Sebenzisa amandla angu-6 Omholi Omkhulu ukucekela phansi iyunithi yokugcina yesitha.
halowarsde-33.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Walk-off Winner" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, shiya isitha neyunithi eyodwa, bese usebenzisa elinye lamandla akho amakhulu omholi ukuze usibhubhise. Bamba umlilo webutho lakho njengoba uwumisa ukuze amandla athole igalelo lokugcina.

halowarsde-21.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Beaming with Pride" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Beachhead, sebenzisa i-Spartan ukuduna i-Scarab. Yilawule ngokuqondile futhi uqondise izitha zakho kuze kube yilapho sezicekele phansi angu-25. Gcina amayunithi asekela eduze ngaphandle kokubavumela babulale obala.

halowarsde-17.description: I-Mission 9: Faka yonke i-Colony ku-Hibernation Mode ngesikhathi esifanayo.
halowarsde-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Sweet Naptime" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala iSikhukhula, wenze buthaka amakoloni azungeze imephu, futhi ushiye amandla elungile endaweni ngayinye. Zibeke phansi zisondele ndawonye ukuze wonke amakholoni abe sebusika ngesikhathi esifanayo.

halowarsde-52.description: Qedela umsebenzi owodwa ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halowarsde-52.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Racing the Clock" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele umkhankaso owodwa womkhankaso ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezikhonjiswe kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-42.description: Win 10 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-42.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Basically Naïve" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-10 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-4.description: Thuthukisa isikolo sakho kunoma iyiphi Inhloso Yomkhankaso.
halowarsde-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Crushed Colors" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha umkhankaso onomphumela orekhodiwe. Yidlale futhi futhi uthuthukise umphumela ngokuqeda ngokushesha, ngokugwema ukulahlekelwa, noma ukuzuza amaphuzu amaningi okulwa. Qedela umsebenzi ukuze kuqoshwe amaphuzu aphezulu amasha.

halowarsde-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Battened Down the Hatches" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, kokuthi Cleansing, vikela yonke i-airlock kuZamcolo. Sabalalisa amandla edekhini ukuze iqembu liphendule ekuhlaselweni nhlangothi zombili. Donsa amabutho ensikeni yokuhlanza, bese ubuyela esimweni lapho isidlulile.

halowarsde-26.description: Qedela noma iyiphi i-Campaign Mission nge-Co-op Mode.
halowarsde-26.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Backscratcher" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, mema omunye umdlali emkhankasweni, bese niqedela umsebenzi ndawonye. I-Alpha Base iyi-run yokuqala emfushane. Hlala emdlalweni kuze kube isikrini semiphumela ukuze umsebenzi ubale.

halowarsde-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Real Winner" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, e-Arcadia City, thola u-Adam futhi usule umzila ophambi kwakhe. Gcina amabutho akho eduze kwakhe aze afinyelele ezokuthutha, futhi ubeke phambili noma yisiphi iSivumelwano esidubula endleleni yakhe.

halowarsde-34.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "2 Bugs are Better Than 1" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Skirmish njengomholi weSivumelwano. Thuthukisa umnotho wakho, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nenani labantu uze ukwazi ukukhokhela ama-Scarab amabili. Yakha kokubili futhi uwagcine ephila ngenkathi usula isisekelo sesitha sokugcina.

halowarsde-23.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Thinkin' about My Doorbell" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, kokuthi Escape, sebenzisa izilawuli zeminyango ngokulandelana kwazo ezihlosiwe. Vikela iphoyinti lokulawula ngalinye bese ulinda umnyango walo ukuze uvule ngaphambi kokuvula olandelayo. Landela ukuhleleka okuboniswe kuvidiyo.

halowarsde-11.description: Injongo yesi-3: Bulala okungenani amayunithi eSivumelwano ama-5 ngeBhuloho.
halowarsde-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Covenant "Hot Drop" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Relic Interior, linda iqembu lamayunithi eSivumelwano ukuthi liye ebhulohweni, bese usebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uliwise. Qinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amayunithi amahlanu asebhulohweni uma uyicisha. Ividiyo ibonisa ukuthi uliletha kuphi iqembu.

halowarsde-36.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Halo Academic" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula imicimbi engu-20 yomugqa wesikhathi ngokuthuthukela emkhankasweni kanye nokuQothulelana nokuqoqa amabhokisi Amnyama. Ekuqaleni, thatha Ibhokisi Elimnyama ku-Alpha Base ukuze uthole indlela eqondile yokuvula umugqa wesikhathi. Hlola umugqa wesikhathi kumenyu ukuze ubone ukuthi yini evuliwe.

halowarsde-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Rhino Hugger" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Dome of Light, phelezela wonke uRhino endaweni yawo emakiwe futhi ugcine ngamunye ephila. Hambisa amayunithi okulwa ngaphambi kohide futhi ushiye abadlali basemuva eduze kwe-Rhinos asebevele beqalile.

halowarsde-43.description: Win 20 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-43.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Officer on Deck" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-20 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Procrastinator" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Shield World, hlola iphoyinti lendlela yensimbi kagandaganda bese uqedela izinjongo zokuphazamiseka ngaphambi kokuhamba. Gcina ibutho lakho linama-platoons njengoba usula izindawo ezizungeze imishayo.

halowarsde-39.description: Dlala i-Halo Wars okungenani amahora angama-24 Ephelele.
halowarsde-39.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "24 Hours of Quality" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qhubeka nokudlala umkhankaso noma i-Skirmish kuze kube igeyimu iqopha ingqikithi yamahora angu-24. Sebenza ngezindondo zomkhankaso noma ukuwina kwe-Skirmish ngesikhathi esifanayo ukuze isikhathi sokudlala sibale kwezinye izimpumelelo.

halowarsde-48.description: Qedela ohambweni oluhlanu ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halowarsde-48.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hardly Tardy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele ohambweni lwemikhankaso emihlanu ehlukene ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezishiwo kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-27.description: Wina i-Skirmish Game nawo wonke umholi.
halowarsde-27.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Playin' the Field" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, sebenzisa isikrini sokusetha i-Skirmish ukuze ukhethe umholi ohlukile kumdlalo ngamunye. Wina kanye njengomholi ngamunye kwabathathu be-UNSC kanye nabaholi abathathu beSivumelwano. Gcina uhlu lokuhlola futhi uqedele ukufana ngakunye esikrinini semiphumela.

halowarsde-44.description: Win 30 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi
halowarsde-44.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Running the Show" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-30 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-50.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lovely Bunch of Coconuts" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qedela umgomo ohlobene wokubulala ibhonasi kumkhankaso ngamunye womkhankaso ukuze wenze ugebhezi lwayo luvele. Thumela iyunithi ukuze uyiqoqe ngaphambi kokuqeda. Qala ngemishini yangaphambi kwesikhathi bese ulandela izindawo ezixhunyiwe uze ube nezigebhezi eziyisishiyagalombili ezihlukene.

halowarsde-8.description: Thola umkhankaso wempilo yakho yonke Amaphuzu angaphezu kuka-1,000,000.
halowarsde-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Epic Grinder" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, yakha amaphuzu omkhankaso ahlanganisiwe angaphezu kuka-1,000,000. Khulisa imiphumela yemishini yamaphuzu aphansi ngokuqeda phakathi nesikhathi esilinganiselwe kanye nokunciphisa ukulahlekelwa kwamayunithi. Sebenza ngezinye izimpumelelo ukuze uthole izindondo zemishini ngenkathi wakha isamba sempilo yonke.

halowarsde-31.description: Wina i-Heroic Skirmish Game ngokumelene ne-AI ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-10.
halowarsde-31.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Big Al's Scooter" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Heroic Skirmish futhi usebenzise ukushesha ngaphambi kokuthi isitha sakhe. Thumela iyunithi yokuhlola ukuze uthole isisekelo, ukhiqize amandla akho okuhlasela ngaphandle kokulibala, futhi uqedele ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-10.

halowarsde-45.description: Win 40 Skirmish noma Imidlalo Yabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-45.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Don’t Stop Me Now" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-40 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-10.description: Injongo yesi-2: Bhubhisa yonke i-Methane Tank.
halowarsde-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Endless Fun" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala futhi i-Relic Approach. Bheka emaphethelweni wendawo ngayinye ye-Methane Tanks bese unikeza amayunithi akho umyalelo wokuhlasela endaweni ngayinye. Shanela umzila wanoma yimaphi amathangi aphelele ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halowarsde-35.description: Thola i-High Score ewinayo enama-squads angu-10 noma ngaphansi uma ubhekene ne-Heroic AI.
halowarsde-35.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Penny Pincher" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Heroic Skirmish futhi ugcine ibutho lakho libe kumaqembu angu-10 noma ngaphansi. Thuthukisa amayunithi onawo, buyisela ukulahlekelwa ngaphakathi kwekhephu, futhi uqedele umdlalo ngokuwina amaphuzu aphezulu.

halowarsde-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Adjudicate the Arbiter" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima boMkhankaso bube yi-Heroic futhi usule yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Gcina ingxubevange yamayunithi alwa nezingane kanye nezimoto, buyisela ukulahlekelwa phakathi kwezimpi, futhi uhlole irekhodi lemishini nganoma yini engaphansi kweHeroic.

halowarsde-46.description: Win 50 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-46.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Maximum Effort" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-50 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-30.description: Thola amaphuzu angu-20,000 kunoma yimuphi umdlalo we-Skirmish.
halowarsde-30.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Titan" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Skirmish futhi wakhe amaphuzu ngokubhubhisa amayunithi ezitha nezisekelo kuyilapho ugcina ukulahlekelwa kwakho kuphansi. Gcina isisekelo sesitha sinde ngokwanele ukuze sakhele kumaphoyinti angu-20,000, bese uqeda umdlalo.

halowarsde-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "He's Got the Jack" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, e-Arcadia Outskirts, sebenzisa abaduni base-Spartan ukuthatha izimoto eziyisithupha ze-Covenant. Shiya ithagethi iphila, khetha i-Spartan ngezinyawo, bese usebenzisa umyalo wokuduna. Phuma emotweni ethunjiwe uma udinga leyo Spartan kwelandelayo.

halowarsde-54.description: Zuza okungenani inani labantu abangu-15 kugagasi elilodwa kugeyimu Yokuqinisa.
halowarsde-54.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Freak on a Streak" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Reinforcement futhi ukhulule isikhala esanele sabantu ngaphambi kwegagasi elilandelayo. Vumela amayunithi amasha ukuthi afike ndawonye futhi uhlole ukuthi igagasi lengeze okungenani inani labantu abangu-15 ngokwalo.

halowarsde-47.description: Wina futhi ungalokothi ulandele kumdlalo we-Tug of War.
halowarsde-47.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Pull Hard, Pull Deep" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha i-Tug of War futhi wakhe amayunithi kusenesikhathi ukuze ugcine amandla akho ephambi kolunye uhlangothi. Shintshanisa ukulahlekelwa ngokushesha, vikela izisekelo zakho, futhi uhlale uboshiwe noma uphambili kubha yenqubekelaphambili uze uwine.

halowarsde-51.description: Win 75 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-51.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Soldier of Ares" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-75 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Detour the Great Journey" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima bomkhankaso kube Inganekwane futhi usule yonke imisebenzi engu-15. Yakha umnotho wakho ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ezimpini ozikhethela zona, hlola ngeyunithi esheshayo, futhi uhlole umgomo olandelayo ekuhambeni okuxhunyiwe lapho umzila uba nzima.

halowarsde-7.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide kuyo yonke Imishini Yomkhankaso.
halowarsde-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Wall of Recognition" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, sebenza kuwo wonke amamishini omkhankaso angu-15 futhi uqedele ngalinye ngeNdondo Yegolide. Ukugijima okuxhunyiwe kunesahluko semishini ngayinye. Sebenzisa irekhodi lesevisi ukuze ubone noma yiliphi izinga elingaphansi kwegolide ngaphambi kokulidlala futhi.

halowarsde-22.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Didn't Get to Second Base" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Reactor usebenzisa kuphela isisekelo oqala ngaso. Yakha ibutho lakho nomnotho lapho, bese usula indlela ye-reactor ngaphandle kokufuna isizinda esingeziwe.

halowarsde-55.description: Qeda ngezinsizakusebenza ezingu-5000 ezinikelwe ozakwenu eSikhumbuzweni ngaphandle kwase-Deathmatch.
halowarsde-55.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Never Leave a Man Behind" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha igeyimu yeqembu ku-Memorial Basin ngemodi engeyona i-Deathmatch. Sebenzisa inketho yentela ukuze uthumele izinsiza zabalingani futhi ulandelele lokho ezikubuyisela emuva. Qeda ngokuthumela okungenani okungu-5,000 kunalokho okutholiwe.

halowarsde-24.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Graverobber" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, umkhankaso ngamunye unogebhezi lwekhanda oluvulwe ngenjongo yokuzikhethela. Qedela leyo nhloso, bese uthumela iyunithi ukuze iqoqe Ugebhezi endaweni oluzalele kuyo ngaphambi kokuqeda. Phinda kuzo zonke izimishini eziyi-15.

halowarsde-29.description: Wina umdlalo kuyo yonke i-Skirmish Game Mode.
halowarsde-29.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Empire Builder" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha i-Skirmish futhi uwine imodi ngayinye yegeyimu etholakalayo. Hlola isikhethi semodi phakathi kokufanayo ukuze umboze i-Standard, Deathmatch, nezinye izindlela ezifakiwe.

halowarsde-49.description: Win 100 Skirmish noma Ukufana Kwabadlali abaningi.
halowarsde-49.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Weapon of Zeus" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, wina ukufana okungu-100 kwe-Skirmish noma kwabadlali abaningi. Ukuze wakhe abawinile ku-Skirmish, khetha imephu encane kanye ne-Easy AI, khiqiza amandla okuhlasela angaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi ukhiphe isisekelo sesitha ngaphambi kokuthi sande. Qedela esikrinini semiphumela ukuze ukuwina ngakunye kubalwe.

halowarsde-16.description: Injongo yesi-8: Sebenzisa Izindlovu ukuqeqesha amasosha ahamba ngezinyawo ayi-100.
halowarsde-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ramblin' Man" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Ander's Signal, sebenzisa Izindlovu zakho kanye namasosha akho ahamba ngezinyawo kulayini kumamenyu azo okukhiqiza. Gcina Izindlovu zivalekile futhi qhubeka nokushintsha olayini abagcwele kuze kube yilapho usuqeqeshe amasosha ahamba ngezinyawo ayi-100 ngaphambi kokuqeda.

halowarsde-28.description: Wina umdlalo kuwo wonke amamephu we-Skirmish.
halowarsde-28.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Gallivant around the Galaxy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, khetha imephu ongawinanga kuyo ku-Skirmish, shaya i-AI, bese uphinda kumephu ngayinye etholakalayo. Lungisa usayizi wegeyimu ukuze uveze amamephu anezibalo ezihlukile zabadlali.

halowarsde-20.description: Injongo 12: Lungisa I-Power Core ngaphansi kwemizuzu emi-4.
halowarsde-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Handy with Tools" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala Ukulungisa futhi uthumele amayunithi akho e-Cyclops aqonde ku-Power Core. Zigcine emsebenzini wokulungisa futhi usebenzise amanye amasosha akho ukuvimba abahlaseli. Buyisela indikimba ibe namandla aphelele ngaphambi kokuthi kudlule imizuzu emine.

halowarsde-74.description: Phakamisa Amandla Omholi angu-5 asebenzayo kugeyimu eyodwa ku-Blood River.
halowarsde-74.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "KillJoy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Blood River, dlala njenge-UNSC ngokumelene nomholi Wesivumelwano. Gcina Ibhomu Lokuphazamiseka litholakala bese uliphonsa kumholi ngenkathi amandla esebenza. Linda ukupholisa phansi bese uphinda uze uphazamise amandla amahlanu kumdlalo ofanayo.

halowarsde-5.description: Qeda yonke imisebenzi ngaphansi kwe-Par Time kubunzima bobuqhawe.
halowarsde-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mr. Punctual" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha ubunzima ku-Heroic futhi uqedele yonke imikhankaso engu-15 ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezikhonjiswe kumbiko wemishini. Qala nge-Alpha Base, sebenzisa inqama ye-Warthog ukuze usule ama-Grunts ngokushesha, futhi weqe izimpi ozikhethela zona ezehlisa ijubane umgomo oyinhloko. Hlola isikhathi sokuqeda esirekhodiwe ngemva komzamo ngamunye.

halowarsde-15.description: Injongo 7: Ungachithi noma iyiphi i-Power Node.
halowarsde-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Micro Manager" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala i-Scarab futhi ugxilise ukuhlasela kwakho ku-Scarab uqobo. Gcina ama-Power Nodes ngaphandle kwama-oda akho okuhlasela futhi ukhiphe amayunithi akho endleleni ye-beam. Qeda ngaphandle kokucekela phansi inodi.

halowarsde-53.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Living Loving Bug" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha Ukuqiniswa njengomholi Wesivumelwano. Thuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bakho futhi ushiye isikhala esanele sabantu ukuze uthole i-Scarab kugagasi lokuqinisa. Qhubeka nokudlala kuze kufike iyunithi.

halowarsde-57.description: Okushisayo phonsa amaqembu angu-50 kumholi wakho Wesivumelwano kumdlalo owodwa ku-Barrens.
halowarsde-57.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tour Coming Through" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, ku-Barrens, dlala njengomholi weSivumelwano futhi usebenzise lowo mholi ensimini. Qeqesha amaqembu futhi uwathumele nge-base teleporter kumholi. Phinda kuze kube sekufike amaqembu angu-50 emdlalweni ofanayo.

halowarsde-9.description: Injongo 1: Qhama futhi ubulale amaGrunts angama-50 ngama-Warthogs.
halowarsde-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Everything's Better with Bacon" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qala i-Alpha Base bese ukhetha ama-Warthogs akho. Sebenzisa ikhono labo le-Ram emaqenjini e-Grunts esikhundleni sokuvumela i-turret iwaqedele. Qhubeka ugoqa kuyo yonke indlela eya esisekelweni uze ubulale ama-Grunts angu-50 ngale ndlela.

halowarsde-25.description: Thola iphoyinti eliwinile kugeyimu ye-Keepaway ngokumelene ne-Legendary AI's.
halowarsde-25.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "One and Done" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, setha igeyimu ye-Keepaway ngokumelene ne-Legendary AI. Thwebula ifulegi kuze kube yilapho iqembu lakho selithola iphuzu elilodwa kusukela ekuwineni, bese uthwebula futhi ulethe ifulegi lokugcina ngokwakho. Vikela eduze komzila wefulegi ngenkathi ulinde ithuba lokugcina.

halowarsde-6.description: Thola Indondo Yegolide enawo wonke ama-Debuff Skulls Active.
halowarsde-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Own Worst Enemy" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, qoqa ama-Skulls omkhankaso, bese unika amandla i-Rebel Sympathizer, Umsekeli Wezihlubuki, Nomholi Wezihlubuki kumenyu yoKhakhayi. Qalisa umgomo omfushane njenge-Alpha Base futhi usebenzise ama-Warthogs akho ukuze unqande ama-Grunts ukuze ubulale ngokushesha. Qeda ngendondo yegolide.

halowarsde-37.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Halo Historian" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, vula Umugqa Wesikhathi bese ukhomba okufakiwe okukhiyiwe. Qoqa umkhankaso othi Black Boxes futhi uqedele umkhankaso ohlobene kanye nezigigaba ze-Skirmish kuze kube yilapho okungenelayo kuvuliwe. Hlola i-walkthrough exhunyiwe uma ushoda ngomcimbi othile.

halowarsde-73.description: Bulala amaqembu ezitha angu-20 nge-Covenant Leader Power eqhubekayo ku-Sikhumbuzo Basin.
halowarsde-73.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Drain Cleaner" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, dlala ku-Memorial Basin njengomholi Wesivumelwano onekhono eliqhubekayo. Linda amaqembu esitha aqoqwe, bese ugcine amandla esebenza futhi uwaqondise ekwakhekeni. Gcina amandla ayo kanye nezindleko zokuhlinzeka engqondweni njengoba usebenzela ekubulaweni kweqembu okungama-20.

halowarsde-38.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ready for the Sequel" kokuthi Halo Wars: Definitive Edition, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Hlola iphesenti lakho lokuqedwa kurekhodi lesevisi.
2. Zuza Igolide kuyo yonke imikhankaso eyi-15, qedela umgomo okhethekile we-mission ngayinye, futhi uqoqe ama-Skulls nama-Black Boxes.
3. Ku-Skirmish, wina ngomholi ngamunye, kumephu ngayinye, nakumodi ngayinye, futhi ufinyelele amaphuzu angu-20,000 kumdlalo.
4. Hlola i-Halo Historian kanye ne-Epic Grinder nganoma yimuphi umugqa wesikhathi osele noma izidingo zamaphuzu.

halospartanstrike-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Experienced" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, dlala umkhankaso wokuqala kanye nokubulalana eduze ukuze uthole amabhonasi ezindondo. Qedela umgomo uma usufinyelele impokophelo yayo yomphumela weGolide. Ungasebenzisa i-Score Booster esikrinini sokulayisha uma udinga amaphuzu engeziwe. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Welcome to New Mombasa" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation A emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-A-1 kuya ku-A-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Homing in" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation B emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-B-1 ukuya ku-B-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Ready for Departure" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation C emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-C-1 kuya ku-C-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-6.description: Gcina Indlovu iphelele ngo-100% ku-Operation A, Mission 3
halospartanstrike-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "I Am Your Shield" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation A, Mission 3. Uma usungene ku-Warthog, sula umgwaqo nezinhlangothi zombili zomzila wokuphelezela ngaphambi kokuba iNdlovu ikhuphuke. Emgodleni ngamunye, hlola imigwaqo ukuze uthole ama-Grunts okuzibulala futhi uwabhubhise ukude. Gcina i-turret ikhombe kude neNdlovu ukuze kungabi nomlilo wobungani. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Home Sweet Home" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation D emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-D-1 kuya ku-D-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanstrike-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Big Spender" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, ngaphambi kokwethula ohambweni, thenga izikhali, amakhono, noma izithuthukisi ngamakhredithi esikrinini sokulayisha. Qhubeka nokukhetha ukuthuthukisa okusiza ngezinkanyezi zegolide noma izinselele ze-Skull uze usebenzise amakhredithi angu-10,000 esewonke. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-8.description: Ungavumeli ababukeli ukuthi bavuse noma yimaphi ama-Knights ku-Operation C, Mission 4
halospartanstrike-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Night Knight" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, dlala i-Operation C, Mission 4. Kungosi ngayinye, vumela ama-Knights asondele phakathi nendawo ngaphambi kokubabulala ukuze ubone Ababukeli abangena ukuze babavuselele. Beka kuqala Izibukeli futhi ugweme ukushiya imizimba ye-Knight ngaphandle kwesikrini. Bamba lokhu ngengosi yokugcina. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No Loose Ends" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Operation E emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-6, kusukela ku-E-1 kuya ku-E-6. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula. Zuza igolide kuyo yonke inhloso ye-Operations A ukuya ku-D ukuze uyivule kuqala.

halospartanstrike-12.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide ku-Operations A kuya ku-E
halospartanstrike-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Battle Hardened" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, sebenzisa ohambweni abangu-30 kokuthi Operations A kuya ku-E futhi uzuze inkanyezi Yegolide ngayinye. Hlola indondo yakho yamanje esikrinini sokusebenza. Emidlalweni ephindwayo, sebenzisa i-Score Booster futhi iqembu libulale ndawonye ukuze uthole izindondo. Ku-B-5 naku-B-6, ungakha amaphuzu amaningi kumagagasi eduze nokuphela ngaphambi kokuhamba. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanstrike-15.description: Qedela i-Operation A, Mission 6 enogebhezi oluyimpumputhe nokuduma kwezulu olusebenzayo
halospartanstrike-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge A" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla i-Blind and Thunderstorm ngaphambi kokwethula i-A-6. I-Blind isusa i-HUD yakho, ngakho layisha kabusha phakathi kwamagagasi futhi usebenzise ikhava lapho uqala ukuthatha amahithi. I-Damage Booster isiza ngokumelene nezitha ezinamandla. Qeda ngawo womabili ama-Skulls asebenzayo.

halospartanstrike-14.description: Sebenzisa wonke Amandla Ezikhali okungenani kanye
halospartanstrike-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "GEN2" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, sebenzisa okokufundisa ukuze uzame Ikhono Lezikhali ngalinye elitholakalayo, futhi ulandelele lawo owazisebenzisile. Hlola ukulayishwa kwemishini ukuze uthole amakhono engeziwe angathengwa ngamakhredithi. Hlomisa ikhono ngalinye elishodayo futhi ulisebenzise kumishini.

halospartanstrike-7.description: Gcina i-Wraith 100% iqinile ku-Operation B, Mission 4
halospartanstrike-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Not a Scratch" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation B, Mission 4 bese uthatha i-Wraith. Shisa udaka ngesango lokuqala ukuze usule izitha eziseduze ngaphambi kokubhubhisa i-generator yayo. Kwijeneretha yesibili, misa eceleni ngaphambi kokucupha igagasi elilandelayo. Shiya i-Wraith ngemuva kwekhava ngenkathi usula izindawo lapho ongakwazi khona ukubona kude ngokwanele ukuze usebenzise udaka. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-16.description: Qedela i-Operation B, Mission 6 ene-Hollow and Pacifist Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge B" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla i-Hollow ne-Pacifist ye-B-6.
