Sebenzisa i-Kestrel ukuze unqamule izitha ngesikhathi sokusondela futhi ulondoloze amabhomu akho ukuze uvikeleke endaweni yokufikela. Qhubeka uzungeza ikhava kuze kufike i-Pelican, njengoba ukudubula ngaphansi kwe-Pacifist kukhipha isivikelo sakho.

halospartanstrike-18.description: Qedela i-Operation D, Mission 6 ngeNdlala Nogebhezi Lwezikhukhula ezisebenzayo
halospartanstrike-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge D" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, nika amandla Indlala Nokuduma kwe-D-6. Sebenzisa izikhali kuma-rack emaphethelweni emephu ukuze umiselele ama-pickup ane-ammo ephansi njengoba kudingeka. Beka kuqala izitha eduze Nonjiniyela ngenkathi isebenza kuphothali futhi inebha yezempilo.

halospartanstrike-17.description: Qedela i-Operation C, i-Mission 6 ene-Black Eye ne-Pacifist Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge C" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Black Eye ne-Pacifist ku-C-6. Sebenzisa i-melee ezitheni ezincane ukuze ubuyisele izihlangu, bese umangaza ama-Knights anamandla ngamabhomu ngaphambi kokuvala. Endaweni yokudonsa, sebenzisa amabhomu anamathelayo ngokumelene nama-Knights aqinile kanye nebhodi lapho umgomo usuphelile.

halospartanstrike-9.description: Qedela i-Operation D, Mission 5 ngaphandle kokushaywa i-Focus Turret
halospartanstrike-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Beam Dance" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation D, Mission 5 futhi usondele ku-Focus Turret ngayinye usebenzisa ikhava. I-Teleport ngemuva kwe-turret uma iqala ukukulandela, bese usebenzisa amabhomu ukuyikhipha. Thatha amabhomu amangalisayo ngemva kokuzivikela okunesikhathi ukuze uphathe iqembu lokugcina, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokukushaya kwe-Focus Turret. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanstrike-10.description: Ungashaywa yinoma iyiphi i-Proximity Mines ku-Operation E, Mission 2
halospartanstrike-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mine Sweeper" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, qala i-Operation E, Mission 2 futhi ubuke izimayini ezibekwe eceleni komzila noma eziwiswe amaBrutes. Thatha i-Bubble Shield kuma-Elite ekuqaleni kwe-mission futhi uyisebenzise ngaphambi kokuba imayini iqhume. Gwema kokubili ukuqhuma nezinaliti ezizikhululayo.

halospartanstrike-19.description: Qedela i-Operation E, Mission 6 eneHollow and Black Eye Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanstrike-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge E" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula i-Hollow ne-Black Eye ku-E-6. Thatha i-turret eduze nasekuqaleni bese ugxila ezansi kuma-Knights ngaphambi kokuthi ayiphule. Sebenzisa amarokhethi kuma-Shade Turrets, futhi uhlukanise izitha ze-melee ukubuyisela izihlangu phakathi kwamagagasi. Gcina umlilo wakho kude ne-dropship ngesikhathi sokuzivikela kokugcina.

halospartanstrike-20.description: Qedela wonke ama-Assault Ops Okusebenza A kuya ku-E
halospartanstrike-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Thorough" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Strike, vula uhlu lwe-Assault Ops lwenjongo ngayinye futhi ulandelele zontathu izinjongo zemishini ngaphambi kokuthi uqale. Dlala kabusha umgomo ohlobene nesikhali, okuhlosiwe, noma indondo esohlwini lwenhloso engaqediwe. Sebenza kuzo zonke izimishini ezingama-30 ku-Operations A kuya ku-E futhi uhlole uhlu lwemishini ngayinye njengoba uhamba.

halospartanassault-11.description: Zuza inkanyezi yanoma yiluphi uhlobo kumishini yokusebenza
halospartanassault-11.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Recruit" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-A-1 futhi uqedele zonke izinjongo zayo. Qhubeka uthwebula emaqenjini ezitha ukuze uthole amaphuzu futhi uqedele umkhankaso ngenkanyezi Yethusi, Isiliva, noma Yegolide. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-6.description: Gcina wonke ama-Wolverine eqinile ku-Operation A, Mission 3
halospartanassault-6.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Escort Service" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-A-3 futhi uhlale ngaphambi kwe-Wolverines lapho ungakwazi khona. Khipha izitha ezisondela ku-convoy ngaphambi kokuthi zingene ebangeni, futhi uqondise amabhomu kude nezimoto ezinobungane. Finyelela esiphethweni ngayo yonke i-Wolverine isaphelele. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-12.description: Zuza inkanyezi yakho yokuqala eGold kumishini yokusebenza
halospartanassault-12.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Prodigy" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala kabusha ileveli yangaphambi kwesikhathi efana ne-A-1 futhi wakhe isikolo sakho ngokwehlisa izitha ngamaqembu asheshayo. I-Score Booster ingakusiza ukuthi usule umkhawulo Wegolide oboniswe kumishini. Qedela izinjongo ngemuva kokufinyelela kuyo. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-1.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Overrun" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation A emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-A-1 kuya ku-A-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-2.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Switched On" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation B emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-B-1 ukuya ku-B-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-18.description: Qedela noma yimuphi umsebenzi womkhankaso ngenani eliphezulu lama-Skulls asebenzayo
halospartanassault-18.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Skull Combo" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, khetha umgomo wangaphambi kwesikhathi owazi kahle. Nika amandla zombili izikhala ze-Skull ezitholakalayo ekulayisheni, bese uqedela umgomo. Khetha ipheya ongakwazi ukuphatha imiphumela yayo ngezikhali zokuqala zalowo mkhankaso.

halospartanassault-3.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Switched Off" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation C emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-C-1 kuya ku-C-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-4.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Evacuated" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation D emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-D-1 kuya ku-D-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-5.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Terminated" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation E emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-E-1 kuya ku-E-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-21.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Archeology" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Operation F emkhankasweni futhi uqedele yonke imisebenzi engu-5, kusukela ku-F-1 kuya ku-F-5. Landela umaka wenhloso yenjongo ngayinye bese uqedela umgomo wokugcina wokuvula impumelelo. Noma yisiphi isilinganiso senkanyezi sanele kulokhu kusula.

halospartanassault-7.description: Qedela umkhankaso ngaphandle kwanoma yimuphi uJakalase ovuselela isihlangu sakhe ku-Operation B, Mission 3
halospartanassault-7.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule i-"Nowhere to Hide" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-B-3 bese ukhumula oJakalasi eyodwa ngesikhathi. Uma usuphule isihlangu, qedela lowo Jakalase ngaphambi kokuba abe nesikhathi sokuzala kabusha. Sebenzisa ibhomu noma ubambe isihlangu ukuze ugweme impi edonsa kanzima. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-22.description: Bhubhisa wonke ama-Mega Turrets ngethangi le-Grizzly ku-Operation F, Mission 2
halospartanassault-22.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Silvertip" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, ku-F-2, thatha ithangi le-Grizzly futhi ulisebenzise ukuze ubhekane negalelo lokugcina kuyo yonke i-Mega Turret. Hlala ethangini lalokho kubulala futhi ugcine ibanga lakho ngenkathi uklelisa isibhamu ngasinye. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-16.description: Thola ukubulala ngaso sonke isikhali esiphathwa ngesandla emkhankasweni
halospartanassault-16.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Weapon of Choice" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, thola okungenani ukubulala okukodwa ngesikhali ngasinye esiphathwayo emkhankasweni. Yenza uhlu lokuhlola bese weqa isikhali kuphela ngemva kokubulala. Sebenzisa izikhali zeSivumelwano ezehlisiwe eceleni kwezinketho ze-UNSC egiyeni lakho lokuqala kanye nokulayisha.

halospartanassault-10.description: Qedela inhloso ngaphandle kokusebenzisa noma yiziphi izimoto/ama-turrets ku-Operation E, Mission 4
halospartanassault-10.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Foot Soldier" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-E-4 ngokuphelele ngezinyawo. Sebenzisa izikhali zakho eziphathwa ngesandla namabhomu ukusula amaqembu, futhi udlule kunoma iyiphi imoto noma imiyalelo ye-turret eginqiwe. Qedela inhloso ngaphandle kokusebenzisa noma yiluphi uhlobo lwesisetshenziswa. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-17.description: Sebenzisa wonke amakhono kumkhankaso okungenani kanye
halospartanassault-17.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Powered by MJOLNIR" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, hlomisa futhi wenze kusebenze ikhono lezikhali zomkhankaso ngamunye okungenani kanye. Shintsha phakathi kwamakhono atholakala kumishini futhi uhlole ukulayisha kwangaphambilini kwanoma yikuphi ongakusebenzisanga. Yenza kusebenze ikhono lokulwa ngaphambi kokudlulela kokulandelayo.

halospartanassault-9.description: Qedela izinjongo usebenzisa kuphela i-Brute Shot, i-melee namabhomu ku-Operation D, Mission 1
halospartanassault-9.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Brute Force" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-D-1 futhi usebenzise kuphela i-Brute Shot, i-melee, namabhomu. Londoloza imizuliswano ye-Brute Shot yamaqembu noma izinhloso ezikude futhi usebenzise i-melee ezitheni ezizimele. Hlala kulokho kuhlasela okuthathu kuze kube yilapho inhloso yokugcina isicacile. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-8.description: Bulala i-convoy target ngaso sonke isibhamu esimile ku-Operation C, Mission 3
halospartanassault-8.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Never Knew What Hit Them" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala i-C-3 futhi usebenzise zonke izibhamu ezimile endleleni. Endaweni ngayinye, hlala phezu kwesibhamu uze ucekele phansi okungenani umgomo owodwa ovela ku-convoy, bese uqhubekela phambili. Shiya iziqondiso ezanele ze-convoy ukuze uthole izibhamu zakamuva. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-19.description: Qedela i-Operation E, Mission 1 eneHollow and Black Eye Skulls esebenzayo
halospartanassault-19.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula i-Hollow ne-Black Eye ngaphambi kokuqala i-E-1. Sebenzisa i-Active Camouflage ukuze ushibilike izitha ezidlule lapho uya ePhantom. Uma udinga ukubuyisela izihlangu, melee isitha esizimele, bese ubuyela ekumbozeni ngaphambi kwempi elandelayo. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-14.description: Zuza u-25,000 XP kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho
halospartanassault-14.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Pension Plan" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, qedela ohambweni bese udlala futhi lapho ungathola khona amaphuzu aphezulu ngokuthembekile. Qhubeka nokuqongelela i-XP yomsebenzi uze uthole u-25,000 usuwonke. Ibhalansi yakho yamanje ingaba ngaphansi uma usebenzisa i-XP ezintweni zokusebenza.

halospartanassault-15.description: Zuza zonke izindondo emkhankasweni okungenani kanye
halospartanassault-15.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Distinguished Service" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, thola indondo yomkhankaso ngamunye okungenani kanye. Sebenza ngohlu lwezindondo ngohlobo, udlala kabusha ohambweni namaqembu ezitha ukuze uthole ama-multikills, impi eseduze yezindondo ze-melee kanye ne-streak, kanye nokuthunyelwa kwezimoto zezindondo eziboshelwe ezimotweni.

halospartanassault-13.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide kuyo yonke imisebenzi yokusebenza
halospartanassault-13.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "117" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, sebenzisa isikrini sokukhetha umgomo womkhankaso ukuze uthole noma yini engaphansi Kwegolide. Dlala kabusha lawo maleveli, uhlanganise ukubulala okusheshayo ukuze uthole izindondo futhi wengeze i-Score Booster lapho iwusizo khona. Qedela umsebenzi wokuqopha inkanyezi entsha. Sula i-Operation F kanye no-A kuye ku-E ngemfuneko yeSteam. Ividiyo ibonisa inhloso yokuvula ukuze isetshenziswe.

halospartanassault-23.description: Zuza zonke izinkanyezi zegolide ku-Operation F
halospartanassault-23.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tour of Duty" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, dlala futhi i-Operation F futhi uzuze Igolide kumishini yayo ngayinye emihlanu. Hlola impokophelo yamaphuzu ngaphambi kokuyivula ngayinye futhi usebenzise amaketanga ezindondo kanye ne-Score Booster uma umfushane. Qedela ukugijima ngakunye ukuze urekhode inkanyezi. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-24.description: Qedela i-Operation F, Mission 4 enogebhezi oluyimpumputhe nokuduma kwezulu olusebenzayo
halospartanassault-24.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Vidmaster Challenge 2.0" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Nika amandla Impumputhe Nokuduma ngaphambi kokuqala i-F-4.
2. Sebenzisa i-Active Camouflage ukuze ufinyelele ama-core cores endaweni ephansi kwesokunxele, ephansi kwesokudla, nangaphezulu kwesokudla, bese uwabhubhisa ebangeni eliphephile.
3. Ngemva komgogodla wesithathu, vula indlela esenyakatho phezu kwebhuloho elikhanyayo ukuya ekuphumeni.

halospartanassault-25.description: Qedela yonke i-Operation F mission Assault Ops
halospartanassault-25.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "A for Effort" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula iphaneli ye-Assault Ops yayo yonke imisebenzi emihlanu ye-Operation F. Phinda udlale noma iyiphi inhloso ngezinjongo ezingahloliwe, uqinisekisa ukuthi ukulayisha kwakho kunesikhali esidingekayo noma ikhono ngaphambi kokwethulwa. Sebenzisa ividiyo njengesithenjwa somzila wale ngxenye yomkhankaso.

halospartanassault-20.description: Qedela wonke ama-Assault Ops aqondene nomkhankaso kumkhankaso A kuya ku-E
halospartanassault-20.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Extra Credit" kokuthi Halo: Spartan Assault, vula iphaneli ye-Assault Ops ngaphambi kwemishini ngayinye kokuthi Operations A ukuya ku-E. Phinda udlale umkhankaso ngamunye ngezinjongo ezingakaqedwa futhi usebenze kuzikhali ezisohlwini noma izindondo kuze kuqedwe wonke ama-Assault Ops ayo.

halocampaignevolved-257.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "The Autumn Leaves" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza phakathi komkhumbi uye ebhulohweni, thatha u-Cortana, bese ulandela indlela yokubalekela eya esikebheni sokukhulula.

halocampaignevolved-525.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Make Them Count" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, hlomisa isikhali esinembayo njengevolovolo noma i-Battle Rifle futhi uqedele izitha eziyi-100 ngama-headshots phakathi nomkhankaso. Gxila kumaGrunt namaJakalase angavikelekile. Hlubula izihlangu ze-Elite ngaphambi komugqa wokuqedela.

halocampaignevolved-258.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Installation 04" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela isigodi ngemva kokufika futhi uphendule izingcingo zokucindezeleka zasolwandle. Sebenzisa i-Warthog phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlenga bese ulandela umaka wokugcina we-evac.

halocampaignevolved-513.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Cranial" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, cosha noma iyiphi i-Skull efihliwe. Ukuze uthole ukulandwa kusenesikhathi, qala i-Pillar of Autumn bese ulandela ividiyo uye ku-Speed ​​Limit. Lalela isiqephu sayo somsindo, bese usebenzisa i-Interact uma ufika kuyo.

halocampaignevolved-524.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Claims Adjuster" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Umthwalo Onzima e-Rally Point Delta ukuze uthole umzila osindayo wemoto. Khomba ezingxenyeni zemoto ezivelile futhi uqhubeke udubula izingcezu zize zihlukane. Udinga izingxenye ezingu-50, ngakho-ke qondisa izingxenye ezihlukene esikhundleni sokubulala imoto kuphela.

halocampaignevolved-259.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Infiltration Anticipation" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa isibhamu se-sniper ukuze usule izitha ezizungeze i-gravity lift, bese ugibela umkhumbi futhi uphelezele uKapteni Keyes lapho ekhishwa.

halocampaignevolved-260.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bee Thirty" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Vikela ulwandle, sebenzisa isiteshi sokuvikela ukuze uvule indawo, bese ufika kuMdwebi wamabalazwe bese ubuyela phezulu ukuze ukhishwe.

halocampaignevolved-263.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "This Stuff is Your History" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngena exhaphozini ungene esikhungweni, bese ulwa nendlela yakho yokubuyela emuva futhi ulandele omaka bokuphuma.

halocampaignevolved-262.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Control Alt Delete" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza emhosheni oneqhwa namabhuloho e-Forerunner. Sebenzisa ikhava ezimotweni, bese weqa indlela yokugcina eya ku-Control Room.

halocampaignevolved-523.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Disarmed" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha umsebenzi onzima weSikhukhula njengeLabhulali. Khomba ezingalweni Zamafomu Empi bese udubula izitho ngazinye, bese uphinda eqenjini elilandelayo. Umgomo izingxenye ezinqanyuliwe eziyi-100, ngakho-ke gxila ezithweni ngaphambi kokuqeda isitha ngasinye.

halocampaignevolved-264.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Protocol Dictates Action" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela i-Monitor, ubambe eduze kwekhava eminyango ekhiyiwe, futhi usebenzise isibhamu ngokumelene noZamcolo oseduze ngaphambi kokukhipha Inkomba.

halocampaignevolved-533.description: Ku-Assault ku-Control Room fika ku-Banshee ngaphambi kwama-Elite.
halocampaignevolved-533.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "That’s My Ride" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-Assault ku-Control Room, thola i-Banshee epakiwe eduze kwebhuloho bese ugijimela isihlalo somshayeli ngokushesha nje lapho umzila uvuleka. Sprint udlule ezinye izitha ukuze ukwazi ukuyigibela ngaphambi kokuthi i-Elite ingene. Uma i-Elite isuka kuqala, zama futhi ukuhlangana.

halocampaignevolved-265.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Double Trouble" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa i-Banshee ukuze ufinyelele i-pulse generator ngayinye. Sula izitha endaweni ngayinye yokufikela ngaphambi kokuphuma.

halocampaignevolved-521.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Plate Tectonics" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha uMdwebi Webalazwe Othule e-Rally Point Charlie ukuze uthole i-Hunter. Vumela u-Hunter azibophezele ekuhlaseleni, agweme eceleni, bese udubula ipuleti lezikhali emhlane walo lize liphuka. Phinda uze uphule amapuleti angu-25.

halocampaignevolved-266.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Captain’s Orders" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza endaweni yokuphahlazeka bese ubuyela emkhunjini. Finyelela kuKaputeni bese ulandela izimpawu zokuphuma ukuze ubaleke.

halocampaignevolved-520.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Bad Gas" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, sebenzisa i-Grunt-heavy ukuhlangabezana futhi uzungeze iqembu ngalinye ukuze ukwazi ukubona amathangi e-methane emhlane wabo. Khomba ithangi futhi uqiniseke ukuthi liyaphuka ngaphambi kokudlulela kuthagethi elandelayo. Phinda uze ucekele phansi ojosaka abayi-100.

halocampaignevolved-268.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Before the Fall" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela u-Johnson emkhunjini we-Covenant futhi usule igumbi ngalinye ngaphambi kokudlulela kumaka wenhloso elandelayo.

halocampaignevolved-269.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Tiger Company" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenza ngokulondoloza ufinyelele ekuhlosweni kweSivumelwano. Sebenzisa ikhava ezungeze ukuhlangana kuka-Hunter futhi ulandele umzila omakiwe oya ekukhishweni.

halocampaignevolved-267.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Dust & Echoes Evolved" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Finyelela egumbini lenjini futhi ucekele phansi ama-reactors avele, bese uthatha i-Warthog uye endaweni yokukhipha ngaphambi kokuthi isibali sikhathi siphele.

halocampaignevolved-270.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Personal Space" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, dlala umgomo kusukela ekuqaleni. Landela izinjongo ngomkhumbi bese udlula endaweni yokuphanyeka. Qedela ukulandelana kokuphunyuka kuSerafi.

halocampaignevolved-271.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Greenhorn" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha okuthi Kulula bese uqedela umkhankaso. Qala ku-Pillar of Autumn futhi udlale kuze kube sekugcineni. Uma usebenzisa i-Mission Select ukuze uhlanze, hlola ubunzima bakho obuqediwe kumishini ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-272.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Birth of a Spartan" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Okuvamile bese uqedela umkhankaso. Qala ku-Pillar of Autumn futhi udlale kuze kube sekugcineni. Uma usebenzisa i-Mission Select ukuze uhlanze, hlola ubunzima bakho obuqediwe kumishini ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-276.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Pillar of Autumn.
halocampaignevolved-276.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Clean Sweep" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Pillar of Autumn futhi uqoqe Umkhawulo Wejubane, Ukhulisiwe, Nokhakhayi Lombono, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Approach". Qala ekuqaleni ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola amagumbi okuqala ngaphambi kokudlulela ebhulohweni. Ividiyo iqala ogebhezini lokuqala.

halocampaignevolved-535.description: Ku-The Maw qedela ukugijima kwe-warthog ngaphandle kokukhishwa ngenkani emotweni yakho.
halocampaignevolved-535.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Clean Lap" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qala i-The Maw kusukela ekuqaleni futhi ufinyelele ekubalekeni kwe-Warthog okunesikhathi. Yehlisa ijubane ngaphambi kokugxuma kanye nokujika okuqinile, gwedla imfucumfucu, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokuphenyisisa i-Warthog noma ukujikijelwa ngaphandle. Ividiyo ibonisa umugqa wokushayela. Ukuqala ngqo endaweni yokubalekela ngeke kulunge.

halocampaignevolved-279.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Silent Cartographer.
halocampaignevolved-279.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Buried Treasure" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-The Silent Cartographer futhi uqoqe i-Bandana, Acrophobia, ne-Hip Fire Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Status Update". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-514.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule "Making a Necklace" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa izingebhezi ezihlukene ezingu-22. Qala ngemishini embalwa yokuqala ngokulandelana bese ubheka i-Mission Select ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izingebhezi ezisadinga ukuqoqwa. Landela ividiyo ngokomgomo ukugwema ukususa indawo kabili.

halocampaignevolved-273.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Heroes Never Die" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Iqhawe bese uqedela umkhankaso. Setha Ukusetha Ngaphambilini Kwesilungisi kokuthi Lutho futhi uvale i-Bandana ne-Acrophobia ngaphambi kokudlala. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ushaje izihlangu zakho futhi ugcine isikhali esinembayo sitholakala ukuze uqedele izitha ngemva kokuhlubula izihlangu zazo.

halocampaignevolved-277.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Successful Search" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Halo futhi uqoqe I-Grunt Funeral, Give & Take, ne-Floor Is Lava Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Forgotten". Bheka okuthi Ukhohliwe ngaphambi kokushiya indawo yokuvula, bese ulandela izitobhi ezintathu ze-Skull kuvidiyo njengoba uthuthukela esigodini.

halocampaignevolved-280.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Assault ku-Control Room.
halocampaignevolved-280.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Stowed in Snow" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-Assault ku-Control Room futhi uqoqe I-IWHBYD, Angry, and Cowbell Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Tangent I". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-281.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-343 Guilty Spark.
halocampaignevolved-281.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Proto Gravemind" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-343 Guilty Spark futhi uqoqe Inkungu, Lokho nje... Akulungile, Futhi Zibuya Izingebhezi, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Tangent II". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-278.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kokuthi Iqiniso Nokubuyisana.
halocampaignevolved-278.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Plundered" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Iqiniso Nokubuyisana futhi uqoqe I-Iron, Endurance Spec, kanye Nezigebhezi Zangaphandle, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Inquisitor". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-282.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Timeless Tomes" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Ilabhulali futhi uqoqe I-Tilt, Pop, kanye Nezigebhezi Zendlala, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Tangent III". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-283.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kokuthi Ama-Betrayals Amabili.
halocampaignevolved-283.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Outpost Discoveries" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha I-Betrayals Okubili futhi uqoqe I-Tough Luck, Iso Elimnyama, kanye Nezigebhezi Zenganekwane, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Alone". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-285.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-The Maw.
halocampaignevolved-285.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "No Rush" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha i-The Maw futhi uqoqe I-Stowed Reload, i-Boom, ne-Thunderstorm Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "Arrival". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-286.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Boarding Action.
halocampaignevolved-286.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Souvenirs" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Isenzo Sokugibela futhi uqoqe Ukungasebenzi kahle, i-Johnny Ammo Seed, ne-Leadhead Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Itheminali ethi "The Path". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-287.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali kugeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu.
halocampaignevolved-287.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Brute Loops" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha Igeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu futhi uqoqe I-Temperamental, Recession, ne-Ghost Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Penitent Report". I-Temperamental ithatha izinyathelo ezintathu ezihlukene. Landela zontathu izigaba kuvidiyo ngaphambi kokushiya umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-284.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Priorities" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha okhiye bese uqoqa i-Catch, Blind, ne-Piñata Skulls, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Consumed". Qala kokuthi Iqhawe noma Inganekwane Yokubamba, bese ulandela ividiyo yokulanda okunesikhathi Ukubamba ngaphambi kokuhlanza amanye amaqoqo.

halocampaignevolved-512.description: Thola zonke izingebhezi namatheminali ku-Heavy Burden.
halocampaignevolved-512.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Parting Gifts" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, layisha I-Heavy Burden futhi uqoqe i-Eye Patch, i-Grunt Birthday Party, kanye Nezigebhezi Ezisebenzayo, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi wenze kusebenze Isikhumulo se-"Harmonious Clarity". Buka i-cue yomsindo we-Skull njengoba usondela endaweni ngayinye yokucasha, bese usebenzisa i-Interact ukuze uyithathe. Yenza kusebenze Itheminali ngaphambi kokuqeda umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-517.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "REMIX!" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa noma yiziphi Izikhakhayi ezintathu ukuze uvule i-Campaign Remix. Khetha i-Campaign Remix kumenyu, qala i-mission kokuthi Easy, bese uyiqeda kusukela ekuqaleni. Izikhali ezixubene nesitha zingashintsha, ngakho hlola ukuthi yini ephumayo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ekulweni ngakunye.

halocampaignevolved-274.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Living Legend" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha Inganekwane bese uqedela umkhankaso. Setha Ukusetha Ngaphambilini Kwesilungisi kokuthi Lutho futhi uvale i-Bandana ne-Acrophobia ngaphambi kokudlala. Sebenzisa ikhava ukuze ushaje izihlangu zakho futhi ugcine isikhali esinembayo sitholakala ukuze uqedele izitha ngemva kokuhlubula izihlangu zazo.

halocampaignevolved-515.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Headhunter" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa zonke izingebhezi ezintathu kumishini ngayinye kweziyi-13 zengqikithi engu-39. Sebenzisa isahluko ngasinye sevidiyo ukuze uhlole inhloso eyodwa ngesikhathi. I-Catch Skull in Keyes idinga umgijimo Wobuqhawe noma Oyinganekwane.

halocampaignevolved-275.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Lore Have Mercy" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, yenza kusebenze Itheminali eyodwa kumishini ngayinye kweziyi-13, okuhlanganisa nemishini emithathu ye-prequel. Sebenzisa izahluko zetheminali kuvidiyo futhi uhlanganyele nedivayisi ngayinye ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke.

halocampaignevolved-531.description: Khipha uKaputeni Keyes futhi ucuphe amasosha akhe ayisithupha aphindiselayo esibayeni sokubuka sase-Autumn.
halocampaignevolved-531.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "This is My Ship Now" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-Pillar of Autumn, finyelela ibhuloho futhi ukhiphe uCaptain Keyes. Ngena esibayeni sokubuka ukuze wonke amaMarine ayisithupha abeza emva kwakho akulandele. Shelelisela udlule kuwo uye lapho ophuma khona bese uvale ayisithupha ngaphakathi. Landela ividiyo ukuthi ume kuphi nokuthi uhambe nini.

halocampaignevolved-537.description: Lalela i-Thirsty Grunt ikhuluma ngendlela yakhe yokudla.
halocampaignevolved-537.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Food Critic" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, eduze nasekupheleni kokuphunyuka kwe-The Maw’s Warthog, thatha indlela eseceleni eya ku-Thirsty Grunt. Shiya i-Warthog, ume eduze ngokwanele ukuze umuzwe, bese ulinda ulayini wakhe mayelana nokuthi ubekade ekudlani ngaphambi kokuba uhambe.

halocampaignevolved-516.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Collector’s Addition" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa wonke ama-Skulls angu-39 futhi wenze kusebenze zonke iziTheminali ezingu-13. Sebenza ngevidiyo umgomo owodwa ngesikhathi, ucoshe izingebhezi ezintathu futhi usebenzise Itheminali eyodwa endaweni ngayinye. Hlola izinto zokubala eziqoqiwe zemishini ukuze uthole noma yini oyigejile ngaphambi kokuqala elandelayo.

halocampaignevolved-538.description: Qedela noma yiliphi izinga kubunzima beHeroic noma ngaphezulu ngaphandle kokulimaza impilo.
halocampaignevolved-538.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "All Shield, No Yield" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, khetha ileveli emfushane njenge-Pillar of Autumn bese uqala kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Heroic. Lapho izitha zikhipha izihlangu zakho, buyela ekhava bese ulinda ukuthi zishajwe kabusha. Qeda ngaphandle komonakalo empilweni yakho kulo lonke izinga. Setha Ukusetha ngaphambilini Isilungisi kokuthi Lutho ngaphambi kokuqalisa.

halocampaignevolved-522.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "New Whip" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, sondela ezimotweni zesitha ezihlezi endaweni engaphandle bese usebenzisa umyalo wokuduna ukuze uhlale esihlalweni somshayeli. Sebenzisa ikhava yebanga eliseduze ukuze uhambisane ne-Ghost, bese ugibela lapho idlula noma yehla isivinini. Phinda ukuthatha izikhathi ezingu-10.

halocampaignevolved-518.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Beat the Drop" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa izingebhezi ezintathu, bese uqala i-Pillar of Autumn kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Campaign Remix kokuthi Easy. Gcina I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho futhi usule igumbi ngalinye ekhavani ngaphambi kokudlulela phambili. Qeda umsebenzi ngaphandle kokufa.

halocampaignevolved-532.description: Qedela Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule ngaphandle kokudubula, usebenzisa amabhomu, i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.
halocampaignevolved-532.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Map Quest" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qala Umdwebi Webalazwe Othule kusukela ekuqaleni kokuthi Easy Nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
2. Sebenzisa i-Warthog ekuhambeni futhi ugijime noma ushayele izitha ezedlule.
3. Yenza kusebenze isiteshi sokuvikela kanye noMdwebi wamabalazwe, bese ufinyelela ekukhishweni ngaphandle kokudubula, ukujikijela amabhomu, ukusebenzisa i-melee, ukufa, noma ukuqala kabusha.

halocampaignevolved-527.description: Nge-Temperamental Skull ecushiwe shaya i-Halo ngaphandle kokucasula noma ubani.
halocampaignevolved-527.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Even Tempered" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Temperamental ku-The Most Dangerous Game futhi uyinike amandla ngaphambi kokuqala i-Halo. Gcina isibhamu sakho namabhomu kude namasosha asemanzini kukho konke ukuhlangana nokuhlenga. Uma isitha siseduze nomuntu onobungani, beka kabusha isibhamu esicacile ngaphambi kokudubula.

halocampaignevolved-529.description: Hlomisa Indlala, Ukwehla Komnotho, kanye Nogebhezi Lwesihlahla sika-Johnny Ammo futhi unqobe umgomo ngaphandle kokuphelelwa yizinhlamvu.
halocampaignevolved-529.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Frugal Fire" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Famine, Recession, ne-Johnny Ammo Seed, bese unika amandla womathathu ngaphambi kokuqala i-mission emfushane kokuthi Easy. Gcina zombili izikhali zigcwele, sebenzisa ikhava ukuze uhambe eduze kwezitha, futhi ushintshe izikhali ngaphambi kokuba zome. Qeda ngokusetha ngaphambilini kwe-Modifier kokuthi Lutho.

halocampaignevolved-526.description: Nge-Floor Is Lava Skull evuliwe shaya umgomo ngaphandle kokugxuma noma ukufa.
halocampaignevolved-526.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Hot Streak" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Floor Is Lava ku-Halo futhi uyinike amandla okwenza umgomo owazi kahle. Qala kokuthi Easy Nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho. Landela umzila osezingeni eliphansi, gcina okokufaka kwakho kwe-jump kungathintwa, futhi uqedele ngaphandle kokufa. Ividiyo ibonisa umzila ongayilandela.

halocampaignevolved-536.description: Emdlalweni Oyingozi Kakhulu ungabulali ama-Brutes ahlaselayo.
halocampaignevolved-536.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Jiralhanae Conservationist" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, Kugeyimu Eyingozi Kakhulu, gwema ukudubula endaweni yesifuba esikhazimulayo kuma-Brutes ohlela ukuyishiya ephila. Uma i-Brute iqala ukugadla, nqamula umugqa wokubona futhi uqhubeke ngaphandle kokuyibulala. Qala kusukela ekuqaleni ngokuthi I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho futhi uqedele umkhankaso.

halocampaignevolved-528.description: Qedela Ukukhohlisa Okubili ngomkhawulo Wejubane, I-Endurance Spec, i-Hip Fire, kanye Nezigebhezi ze-Armistice ezinikwe amandla.
halocampaignevolved-528.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Like Old Times" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qoqa i-Speed Limit, i-Endurance Spec, ne-Hip Fire, futhi uvule i-Armistice ngokuqoqa noma yiziphi izingebhezi ezintathu. Vula zozine kumenyu yogebhezi, setha Ukusethwa Ngaphambi Kwesilungisi kube Lutho, bese uqedela Ukukhaphela Okubili kusukela ekuqaleni. Sebenzisa ikhava ngaphambi kokugibela futhi ushiye ama-Banshees ejeneretha ngayinye.

halocampaignevolved-534.description: Ku-343 Guilty Spark qedela isitezi sokuqala ngaphandle kokushaya.
halocampaignevolved-534.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Arm's Length" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, ku-343 Guilty Spark, ngena esitezi sokuqala ngaphandle kokushaywa. Sebenzisa ikhava, shiya indawo ezungeze Amafomu Okulwa Nezikhukhula, futhi uqhubeke uhamba lapho ukuphuma kuvulwa. Sebenzisa ividiyo ukuze ubone umzila oqondile odabula phansi. Zama futhi uma ukuhlasela kuxhumekile.

halocampaignevolved-519.description: Qedela wonke umkhankaso oxutshwe kabusha ngaphandle kokufa.
halocampaignevolved-519.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "Mix Master" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Vula i-Campaign Remix ngokuqoqa noma yiziphi izingebhezi ezintathu.
2. Dlala umkhankaso oxutshwe kabusha ku-Easy kusukela kumishini yokuqala nge-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
3. Hlala ngemuva lapho amaqembu ezitha ongawazi ezala, hlola izikhali zakho phakathi nokuhlangana, futhi uqedele wonke umkhankaso ngaphandle kokufa.

halocampaignevolved-530.guideDescription:
Ukuze uvule okuthi "MYTHIC" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, landela lezi zinyathelo.

1. Qoqa ama-Skulls angu-17 adingekayo ku-LASO, bese ukhetha i-Play LASO bese uqedela umkhankaso ngokuthi I-Modifier Preset isethwe kokuthi Lutho.
2. Iso Elimnyama likwenza ube ne-melee ukuze uthole izihlangu, futhi ukufa uwedwa kuqala kabusha umkhankaso.
3. Gcina izihlangu phezulu ngaphambi kokuphokophela phambili futhi usebenzise indlela yokuhamba exhunyiwe ukuhlela ukuhlangana ngakunye.

halocampaignevolved-539.guideDescription: Ukuze uvule okuthi "Fully Evolved" kokuthi Halo: Campaign Evolved, qedela indaba futhi wenze ohambweni lokuqala, qoqa wonke ama-Skulls angu-39 namatheminali angu-13, futhi usebenzele ekufezeni inselele. Londoloza i-Remix engafi nemizamo ye-LASO ngemuva kokuhlangana kwakho. Hlola uhlu lwezimpumelelo ukuze uthole noma yiziphi izinjongo zemishini ezisasele ngaphambi kokuqala ukuhlanza.
